* Have at least eight years' post-qualification experience in derivatives and structured finance, including a minimum of two years' post-qualification experience at a law firm ranked as top tier for derivatives and structured finance;

* Have proven project management skills; and
* Have a practising certificate (or equivalent) which entitles them to practise as a lawyer in the UK.

Applicants are therefore required to have a right to reside and work in the UK. As a result of the high volume of applications we receive, it is our policy not to provide individual feedback at the application stage.



A career with Peerpoint is unmatched in the market. Over the last decade, we've helped lead the transformation of legal consulting as a truly credible option alongside private practice and in-house legal careers. We also have one of the most supportive offerings around, all with the full backing of A&O Shearman.

Empowering your development - you'll be fully supported by our experienced team and will have access to A&O Shearman's training, development and networking events, including opportunities to grow your skillset with A&O Shearman's Advanced Delivery & Solutions businesses. On assignment, you'll have access to an A&O Shearman partner and professional support lawyers as well as extensive knowledge resources.

Variety you control - steer your legal career in whichever direction you choose. Whether you're looking for more control, choice or variety, as a Peerpoint consultant you'll have the pick of the best challenges from across a range of sectors.

Let your priorities lead - it's never been more important to find the right balance. That could mean more flexibility over the time you spend between your personal and professional life, whether that's to pursue a passion, spend time with family or take breaks to travel the world.

Futureproof your career - if you need coaching or mentoring, our team can guide you on the range of diverse paths to help you grow your experience. By understanding your needs and supporting you at every step, we'll help you succeed so you can flourish both today and tomorrow.

Job Title: Collection Document Review Consultant

Closing date: 12:00 am, 08 Nov 2026

**Help safeguard the future of Dacorum’s heritage**

Do you have a passion for museum collections, a keen eye for detail and the expertise to bring clarity to complex historic records? Dacorum Heritage is looking for an experienced freelance collections documentation consultant to help strengthen the records behind one of Hertfordshire’s most fascinating local history collections.

## About the opportunity

As the Accredited Museum for the borough of Dacorum, we care for more than 132,000 catalogued artefacts spanning approximately 6,000 years of local history, from the Neolithic period to the present day. Our collections tell the stories of the people, places and communities that have shaped the borough.

Our collections are held at our dedicated Museum Store in Berkhamsted and include objects owned by Dacorum Heritage, Dacorum Borough Council and seven local history organisations.

We are undertaking an important review of our historic documentation to clarify ownership, resolve discrepancies and ensure our records are accurate, consistent and fit for the future. With plans for a new venue and wider changes in local government on the horizon, this is a timely opportunity to make a real and lasting difference to the stewardship of Dacorum’s heritage.

## What will you do?

Working closely with our small, dedicated museum team, you will review historic paper entry forms alongside records held in our MODES collections management system. Your work will help us to:

* Clarify the ownership and collecting status of objects across our collections.
* Investigate discrepancies in historic documentation and identify records requiring further clarification.
* Create up-to-date inventories for our local history organisation partners.
* Improve the accuracy, consistency and reliability of our collections information.
* Produce clear reports to support future collections management and planning.

## Who are we looking for?

We are seeking someone with experience in museum documentation, collections management and historic records. You will bring a methodical, analytical approach, confidence using collections management systems and the ability to investigate complex records with care.

You will also be a clear communicator, able to manage queries sensitively and work constructively with local history organisations. The role requires initiative, flexibility and the confidence to work independently while collaborating with a small, part-time museum team.

Above all, you will understand the importance of accurate documentation in protecting collections, supporting research and ensuring that local heritage remains accessible and well cared for.

## How to apply

Click here for more details  

If you have the skills and experience to help us strengthen the foundations of our collections management, we would love to hear from you.

Please email your CV and covering letter to Melissa Linsey, Museum Manager, at melissalinsey@dacorumheritage.org.uk, using the subject line Application for Document Review Consultant.

Your covering letter should outline your relevant experience, proposed approach to reviewing paper records and MODES data, methods for managing accuracy and ownership queries, approach to communication with local history organisations, availability during the project period and suitability for the role.

**Deadline:** Sunday 8 November 2026.

**Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.**  
  
**Our Team Members:**

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!  
  
We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

## About the Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will own the technical direction of Alpaca's streaming platform - our Redpanda-based event backbone and the user-facing streaming infrastructure. Platform also owns Authentication, Developer Experience and QA, and AI-Native Engineering. Streaming is roughly two-thirds of the job and where we expect you to become the deepest engineer in the company; across the other three you review the designs, hold an informed opinion, and lead the work where they meet streaming.

This is a Staff role, so we are hiring for direction as much as delivery - the engineer who decides what the streaming platform looks like in two years, writes the RFC that gets three teams to agree, and then builds the hard part. We own client-facing and internal services, maintain shared libraries nearly every team depends on, and manage our own deployments. Most of our time goes into Go, but we also write Helm charts, dig through logs and metrics, and get pulled into a wide variety of problems.

#### Things You Get To Do

* Own the architecture of our event streaming platform end to end - Redpanda, the UTS ecosystem, client libraries and user-facing streaming - and set its two-to-three-year direction
* Lead the shift from batch to event-driven across Alpaca's systems, working with the teams who own them rather than around them
* Design user-facing streaming at scale: connection fan-out, slow consumers, backpressure, ordering and delivery guarantees, and the failure modes that only show up on a volatile market day
* Set the standards for event-driven design - schema evolution, topic ownership, replay, idempotency - and own the shared libraries other teams build against, including the cost of versioning and deprecation
* Shape AuthN/AuthZ direction across Alpaca and lead the work where identity meets streaming: authorizing real-time subscriptions, token lifecycle on long-lived connections, multi-tenant isolation
* Help shape how Alpaca builds with AI - the schemas, contracts and event streams you own are the substrate our agentic development platform runs on
* Partner with SRE on chaos testing and game days for the event backbone, and with our QA stream on test tooling and pre-production gates, so resilience is verified rather than assumed
* Lead through influence rather than authority, and multiply the engineers around you through mentoring, design review, and handing off the work that grows people
* Join the Platform on-call rotation and act as technical lead during incidents affecting shared infrastructure

#### Who You Are (must-haves)

* 8+ years of professional engineering experience, including several years running systems at real scale. You write Go, or have deep experience in another strongly-typed language and will pick it up quickly.
* You have architected event streaming systems, not just used them - real production depth in Kafka or Redpanda across partitioning, consumer groups, rebalancing, retention and delivery guarantees, and how each breaks under load.
* You have delivered realtime data to clients at scale (WebSockets, SSE or gRPC streaming) and handled fan-out, slow consumers and backpressure in production.
* You have driven technical direction across team boundaries without formal authority. You can point to the decisions you owned, the RFCs you wrote, and what happened next.
* You have built or maintained libraries many teams depend on, and know what backward compatibility and deprecation actually cost.
* You have mentored senior engineers and left the teams around you better than you found them.
* You have real depth in at least one adjacent area - identity and access, developer tooling and CI, or testing and resilience - and genuine curiosity about the others.
* You know Kubernetes beyond the basics: you can write a Helm chart with relative ease, you understand security best practices, and you have job experience or certifications to prove it.
* You have worked with relational databases - we use PostgreSQL, but we are not picky as long as the fundamentals are solid.
* You have worked at a startup before - you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre-existing processes or documentation.

#### Who You Might Be (nice-to-haves)

* You’ve worked with an IDL or binary serialization format (Protobuf, Avro; we use FlatBuffers) and handled schema evolution across many consumers.
* You have experience with change data capture (Debezium, PeerDB or similar) and understand how Postgres logical replication works.
* You’ve worked on auth systems - OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT lifecycle, Keycloak or Cognito - especially around long-lived connections or machine-to-machine access.
* You’ve built agentic or AI-native developer tooling, or designed systems meant to be operated by agents rather than only by people.
* You’ve run chaos engineering or game days, or built the load and fault-injection testing that makes them worth running.
* You’ve done IaC with Argo CD or Terraform.
* You have experience with Grafana’s observability stack - Prometheus, Tempo and all the rest. You might have even written a PromQL query for a new alert once or twice.
* You’ve worked in fintech or another regulated domain and understand how compliance constraints shape architecture.

### **How We Take Care of You:**

* Health Benefits
* New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
* Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

job_title: Intern, Research - Context and Knowledge Systems for AI
job_description:
**Position Overview**

Modern AI systems increasingly depend on their ability to access and use the right context at

the right time. An important research challenge is how large, evolving bodies of information

should be represented to support reliable inference.

Autodesk Research provides a distinctive setting for this work. Construction projects are rich,

complex information environments whose state changes continuously over time, making

them a compelling domain for studying context and knowledge systems for AI.

As a Research Intern, you will own a focused research problem in this area. You will

investigate new approaches to building and retrieving structured context, develop

experimental prototypes, and evaluate how effectively they support downstream AI

reasoning.

You will work closely with Autodesk researchers and engineers and have substantial freedom

to bring ideas from your own research. Strong contributions may form the basis of an

academic publication and future Autodesk research.

  

**Responsibilities**

• Conduct original research in context and knowledge systems for AI. Investigate

methods for representing and retrieving information to support reliable contextual

inference

• Develop new approaches to context construction. Explore how relevant knowledge

can be identified and assembled dynamically from large and evolving information

environments

• Build research prototypes. Implement experimental systems using graph-based,

semantic or hybrid approaches and apply them to realistic project information

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments. Develop suitable research questions,

baselines and evaluation methods to understand the strengths and limitations of

proposed approaches

• Collaborate with Autodesk researchers and engineers. Work across AI research,

software engineering and domain expertise to refine ideas and translate them into

experimental systems

• Communicate research findings. Present results within Autodesk Research and

contribute, where appropriate, to research papers, technical reports and

demonstrations

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

• Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Data Science, Information Science or a closely related field, with at least one

academic term remaining after the internship

• Research experience in an area related to knowledge representation, information

retrieval, data management or contextual information systems for AI

• Strong programming skills and experience developing experimental research

software

• Understanding of contemporary AI systems and how retrieval and contextual

information support modern reasoning or agentic workflows

• Experience formulating research questions and designing empirical evaluations.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Research experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:

• Knowledge graphs or graph-based information systems

• Advanced information retrieval and hybrid retrieval methods

• Retrieval-augmented generation, including GraphRAG or related approaches

• Context engineering or memory architectures for AI systems

• Semantic and structured knowledge representation

• Temporal, provenance-aware or evolving data systems

• Heterogeneous data integration at scale

• Graph machine learning applied to representation or retrieval

A strong research publication record in a relevant area is desirable

  

Prior experience with architecture, engineering or construction is not required. We are

particularly interested in candidates with deep technical expertise who are motivated by the

opportunity to test their research against a complex real-world information environment.

  

**About the Team**

Autodesk Research explores technologies that may shape how the world is designed and

made. We work across fundamental and applied research, developing new ideas and testing

them against problems grounded in professional practice.

The Intelligent Construction team investigates how emerging forms of AI can support a more

connected and adaptive construction industry. An important part of that challenge is

understanding how fragmented project information can become a coherent and evolving

source of knowledge for intelligent systems.

You will join a multidisciplinary research environment with expertise spanning AI, data

systems, software engineering and construction. You will work closely with experienced

researchers while having substantial ownership of your own research problem.

Expected Research Outcome

This is a focused **12-week research internship**. The research question will be developed with

the successful candidate to make use of their existing expertise while addressing a problem

relevant to the team's research direction.

By the end of the internship, we expect the intern to have developed and evaluated an original

approach to a clearly defined research problem. This should include a working research

prototype, rigorous experimental evidence and a clear account of the findings and limitations.

The work will be shared within Autodesk Research. Where the research contribution warrants

it, we would expect to develop the work toward publication at an appropriate academic

venue.

The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release.

The platform has two layers working together: an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient.

This is a startup inside an established company. You get genuine early-stage ownership and real influence over architecture and product direction, backed by Bain's global scale, client relationships, and leadership commitment; the pace of a startup with the runway of a global firm.

We are looking for DevOps engineers who see how to make the platform more reliable and resilient and bring that instinct to every sprint without being asked, and who are comfortable with problems that do not have a known answer. Experience supporting agentic systems matters: how AI backend services are deployed and monitored, evaluation pipelines, and the operational demands of production LLM workloads. The DevOps Engineer works directly under the Senior DevOps Engineer within the Growth AI Performance System Platform and Security team, contributing to the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability systems that the entire platform runs on. This is a hands-on implementation role: you will build and maintain the infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and developer tooling that the engineering team depends on, working under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer and developing progressively more ownership as you grow.

You will get broad exposure to the full platform stack: from the infrastructure that hosts AI services and data pipelines through to the deployment workflows that get product changes into the hands of real users on live engagements. This cross-cutting view makes it an excellent role for an engineer who wants to develop deep expertise in cloud-native platform engineering and AI infrastructure in a fast-moving, production environment.

You will work across the platform and product modules focused on marketing ROI, brand, and pricing strategy, contributing to the infrastructure and deployment systems that keep those modules running reliably for enterprise clients. When something goes wrong in a live client deployment, the DevOps team is in the room.

This role is based in Warsaw or Sao Paulo, working as part of a globally distributed platform team alongside the Senior DevOps Engineer. You will develop the infrastructure engineering skills and platform knowledge to take on increasing ownership over time, with a clear path toward the Senior DevOps Engineer role.

· Support the maintenance of environment parity across development, staging, and production; contribute to environment provisioning, configuration management, and the automation that keeps environments consistent and reliable

· Build and maintain infrastructure automation scripts and configuration management tooling; learn and apply infrastructure-as-code practices to all infrastructure changes, ensuring changes are versioned, reviewed, and deployed through code

· Contribute to the design and implementation of infrastructure for AI platform workloads: container orchestration, API management, and the storage and compute patterns that LLM services and agentic workflows require

CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling

· Support release engineering operations: contribute to deployment coordination, monitor deployments in progress, and participate in rollback and incident response procedures

· Learn and develop fluency with the full CI/CD toolchain and deployment workflow; take on progressively more ownership of specific pipeline areas as your expertise grows

Observability, monitoring and incident support

· Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for platform services: set up structured logging, metrics collection, and alerting thresholds that give the engineering team visibility into service health and surface issues before they affect live client deployments

· Contribute to the build of AI and agentic observability tooling under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer: implementing tracing for agentic execution, monitoring LLM API usage and latency, and structured logging for multi-step agent workflows

· Support incident response for infrastructure and platform failures: monitor alerts, participate in diagnosis, contribute to remediation, and document findings in a form that supports post-incident review and platform improvement

· Develop familiarity with the platform's SLOs, alerting thresholds, and reliability standards; learn to read platform health dashboards accurately and understand what degradation signals require escalation

About you

Technical

· Solid foundation in cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS: compute, networking, storage, and managed services; growing proficiency with provisioning and managing cloud resources through infrastructure-as-code

· Working experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation: able to build, maintain, and debug pipeline stages including automated testing, artifact management, and deployment steps

· Proficiency with Docker and containerized deployments; working familiarity with Kubernetes-based orchestration in a production environment

· Proficiency in Linux administration and scripting (Python and Bash) for infrastructure automation tasks; disciplined use of version control for infrastructure codebases

· Working knowledge of monitoring and alerting tooling: able to set up structured logging, configure metrics collection, and create alerting rules that surface meaningful signals

· Exposure to or genuine interest in MLOps and AI infrastructure patterns, how LLM services are deployed and monitored, and what the infrastructure requirements of agentic systems look like in production

· Understanding of security fundamentals for cloud-native infrastructure: IAM, secrets management, network security, and the DevSecOps practices that embed security into deployment workflows

· Active use of AI-assisted development tools to accelerate infrastructure work, diagnose issues faster, and develop AI infrastructure skills

· Experience with or strong interest in MLOps and AI infrastructure; exposure to LLM service deployment, agentic system infrastructure, or vector database workloads is a strong advantage

· Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams; strong troubleshooting skills and comfort debugging infrastructure issues across distributed systems

· Based in or able to work from Warsaw or Sao Paulo near a Bain office

Education

Розвиток аналітичних навичок — поступове пересування від простих запитів і досліджень до складніших задач, формування гіпотез та пошук інсайтів.
Роботу на стику аналітики та AI — знайомитися з AI-інструментами, автоматизацією та особливостями роботи AI-продукту.
Можливість вирости в самостійного аналітика — отримувати зворотний зв'язок від команди, закріплювати знання на практиці та поступово брати більше відповідальності за свої задачі.

Твоя зона впливу
Працювати з маркетинговими, продуктовими та платіжними даними, вчитися знаходити закономірності й розуміти, як різні фактори впливають на результати продукту.
Знайомитися з особливостями subscription-бізнесу: досліджувати доходи, підписки, їхню ціну та тривалість, розуміти основні метрики й фактори, що впливають на revenue.
Вивчати продуктові метрики, аналізувати їхню динаміку та вчитися визначати фактори, які можуть впливати на ключові бізнес-результати
Виявляти патерни поведінки користувачів, перетворювати їх на гіпотези та знаходити нові можливості для розвитку продукту.
Будувати аналітичні репорти й дашборди, які допомагають командам бачити повну картину та приймати рішення на основі даних.

Для цього тобі знадобиться
Не обов'язково знати все з першого дня. Для нас важливі хороша аналітична база, цікавість до роботи з даними та готовність навчатися. Ти працюватимеш із реальними задачами, отримуватимеш підтримку команди й поступово розвиватимеш навички, необхідні для самостійної роботи аналітика.
Комерційний досвід не обов'язковий, але важливо мати базову підготовку в аналітиці - пройти профільні курси або навчальну програму та опанувати основи роботи з даними.
Базові знання SQL: розуміння того, як отримувати, фільтрувати, групувати й об'єднувати дані. Досвід роботи з BI-інструментами буде перевагою.
Базове розуміння статистики та інтерес до експериментів. Знання принципів A/B-тестування буде перевагою, але ми готові допомогти розібратися в цьому напрямі.
Базові знання Python або бажання опанувати його для роботи з даними будуть перевагою.
Аналітичне мислення — здатність логічно міркувати, помічати закономірності, ставити запитання, перевіряти припущення та аргументувати свої висновки.
Самостійність у навчанні — здатність шукати інформацію, розбиратися в нових темах, ставити уточнювальні запитання, працювати зі зворотним зв'язком і доводити задачі до результату.
Уміння послідовно пояснювати хід своїх думок, аргументувати рішення та зрозуміло доносити результати своєї роботи.

# Force Control Room London - Communications Officer

## Job Introduction

**Salary:** Starting salary of **£46,825.48** per annum which consists of a base salary of **£33,792.07** plus 20% Shift allowance, £1,500 Market Supplement and **£4,775.00** London Allowance.

**Contract Type:** Permanent

**Location:** Force Control Room at Palestra House, London

**Type of Working Arrangement:** Office working 

**Hours:** The working hours for this role can be unsocial as it involves a 24/7/365 shift pattern that include early starts, late finish times and night shifts. Nevertheless, working as a Communication Officer for BTP offers a career that is incredibly stimulating, exiting and fulfilling. 

British Transport Police (BTP) is the national police force for the rail network throughout Great Britain. We are the ‘Guardians of the Railway,’ putting passenger safety at the heart of what we do. Our values are simply: We Care, We Do the Right Thing, We Strive to Be Better Every Day, We Are One BTP, and We Are Proud to Protect. Join us and help create an environment where we can all be our best every day.

**The Opportunity:**

Calls can come at any time, which is why our Communications Officers work within a core shift pattern that covers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. This vital role involves answering both emergency and non-emergency calls and directing police resources across Great Britain to where they’re needed most.

As part of our dedicated team, you’ll receive comprehensive training and ongoing support to prepare you for the wide variety of calls and responsibilities you’ll encounter. Whether it’s a life-threatening emergency or a routine enquiry, your ability to remain calm, compassionate, and professional is essential. You’ll need to think on your feet, provide reassurance, and gather accurate information to ensure the appropriate police response is deployed swiftly and effectively.

In return, we offer an attractive salary and a dynamic operational role where you’ll play a key part in protecting the public and our stakeholders from harm and making a real difference every day.

 

**As a****Communications Officer, you will be working in a safety-critical role and be responsible for:**

* Handling calls, dispatching radio messages, and managing police responses to incidents.
* Accurately recording information and assessing it to determine the appropriate level of responses.
* Effectively managing emergency telephone calls, evaluating the urgency of the incident, and prioritising police responses when necessary.
* Obtaining and evaluating information to determine response criteria and deployment levels using THRIVE and NSIR, prioritising public and officer safety at all times.
* Monitoring incidents and providing advice, deployment and direction of appropriate resources via radio to ensure a suitable and effective responses.

**Essential Skills:**

* Effective communication skills.
* Excellent customer service skills and the ability to make decision based on threat, risk and harm.
* Manage situations in a calm and assertive manner.
* Utilising different communication methods (e.g. telephone, radio, email).
* Proficiency in IT and the ability to use multiple integrated systems and with excellent keyboard skills. You must be able to capture information in a timely and accurate manner during the contact.
* Working as part of a team in a control room/contact centre environment.

**What we offer:**

* 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 30 days after 5 years.
* Family-friendly policies, including up to 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave.
* Bespoke benefits platform and Blue Light Card access.
* Salary sacrifice options for cycles, home technology, gym membership, and electric vehicles.
* Interest-free annual rail season ticket loan after 6 months.
* Access to the Transport Benevolent Fund for health, welfare, and financial support.
* Development opportunities, including fully funded apprenticeships.
* Excellent Pension scheme:  We offer the BTP GPP Police Staff Pension Scheme, administered by Royal London. This group personal pension plan is available to all police staff and is a defined contribution scheme. It provides the flexibility to vary your pension contributions from 4.4% to 12% of your salary. For more information, visit the Royal London dedicated pension page or email us at Pension-Queries@btp.police.uk. Note: If you are an existing member of Police Staff in the RPS, your pension will not be affected.

 

**Vetting:** Successful applicants will be required to pass Recruitment/Management Vetting (3 years minimum UK residency required), including a full background and financial disclosure. For more information and Top Tips, please see attached document. 

**Medical:** We’ll ask for relevant health and medical history details to support employee wellbeing. 

**References:** We'll ask for references to cover the past 5 years.

**Additional Information:** 

**Interview process:** This role involves a first stage telephone interview, followed by prioritisation, typing and listening tests which upon successful completion will lead to a face-to-face competency based interview. 

 

***Further information about this vacancy can be found in the attached job description.***

**How to apply****:**

Applications will be via an up to date CV and online application form, as part of this application please outline how your skills and experience demonstrate your suitability for the role.

*Completed applications must be submitted by **11****.59am on 16th November 2026.**(Please note, BTP reserves the right to close the application process early should we receive a large number of applications).*

**Inclusion & Diversity:**

At BTP, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued. We believe diversity drives innovation and better decision-making. Our roles are open to everyone, and we encourage applications from underrepresented groups, including Black, Asian, and minority ethnic candidates, women, LGBTQI+ individuals, people with disabilities, and those who are neurodiverse. As part of our commitment we operate a ‘Disability Confident Scheme’ - all candidates who declare a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role will be offered an interview.

For more information on Inclusion or the Disability Confident Scheme, please click the links Inclusion & Diversity Disability Confident Scheme

**Join Us:** 

Grow your career with us. We can’t wait to hear from you! See why BTP is right for you and click here for more information. For further information, please contact our Resourcing Team at RecruitmentTeam@btp.police.uk.

Growing Build requires a radically different approach to company building. As a company we're focused on one outcome: winning. Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all-in.
Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration.
Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that's where most of the returns are realized.
Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You're meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it.
Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. You probably have a quirky hobby or story that relates to your love for building.
Integrity: You chose to do the right thing even when it isn't easy.
Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it's the only way to do truly extraordinary things.

What we offer

An accelerated founder's track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company - Product judgment, execution speed, and accountability - there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is for grabs.

**What you’ll be responsible for**

Circle is building its enterprise business across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Your role will be to design and execute a strategy to help our partners implement, launch and grow their stablecoin strategy.

  

As Director of Partner Management for Enterprise EMEA, you are the owner of the relationship, from partnership design to launch, adoption and commercial growth. Your portfolio is 10 to 15 strategic partnerships: household-name corporations, and the platforms and institutions that serve them, from the Nordics and DACH to the Gulf and Sub-Saharan Africa.

You will join a small, senior regional team of four covering business development, partner management and solution engineering. Business Development sources and closes. You take over at signature and carry the relationship through implementation, enablement and launch, adoption and expansion. Solution Engineering owns the technical build; you own the plan, the dates, the escalations and the outcome.

  

This is an individual contributor role to start, with the expectation that you establish and scale the partner management function as the segment grows. You will have executive sponsorship, a clear mandate and room to set the standard. You will not inherit a finished process, and for the right person that is the appeal rather than the risk.

**What you’ll work on**

Own the partnership

* Work with Business Development and Solution Engineering before signature to shape deliverable commitments, agree success measures and establish a joint execution plan. Use data-driven tools and AI-enabled synthesis to align stakeholders and produce clear, actionable plans.

* Lead the relationship through plan, implementation, launch and expansion after the partnership signature by the Business Developer.

* Own each partnership from contract signature as the partner’s primary contact at Circle, accountable for time to value and for the go-live dates you agreed.

* Build and run a joint plan for every partnership: the commercial thesis, products and markets in scope, measurable outcomes, named owners on both sides, dated milestones. Leverage automation and AI-assisted reporting to keep the plan current and visible.

* Carry the partner’s blockers to Product, Legal, Compliance, Risk and Operations, and come back with an answer rather than a status.

Turn launches into adoption

* Own the work that turns an integrated partner into a transacting one.

* Train the people who use the product day to day, not only the executive sponsor, until partner-facing teams can represent Circle without us in the room. Use modern enablement approaches — including AI-accelerated learning aids, playbooks and just-in-time training — to scale knowledge transfer.

* Clear the operational, policy and approval dependencies that sit between a signed agreement and real usage. Use tooling and workflow automation to reduce time to value.

* Expand each partnership step by step into further products, currencies, markets and entities, and structure agreements so that growth does not mean reopening them.

* Create expansion and monetization opportunities, which drive value to live partners and work them to close with Business Development.

* Know what each partner is worth to Circle and how much of their business is still available to us, and feed that back to Product, Marketing and regional leadership in a form they can act on. Apply analytical models and AI-enabled forecasting to surface opportunities and risk.

Build the model the segment runs on

* Define the post-signature lifecycle, its stages and its gates, and make it the way the segment operates rather than a document it refers to.

* Set reliable baselines and reporting for the portfolio, then own the targets built on them. Automate reporting where appropriate and use AI-enabled analytics to maintain accuracy and surface insights.

* Codify what works into a model that scales beyond the partnerships you personally manage.

* Build a mechanism to facilitate data-driven portfolio prioritization, partner-health assessment and recovery plans.

* 12+ years managing enterprise partnerships or strategic accounts across the full lifecycle: implementation, adoption, expansion and renewal.

* A record of turning signed agreements into live, growing usage, with the numbers to show it: time to launch, adoption against plan, growth within the account, additional revenue generated by upsell opportunities.

* Deep experience in complex, matrixed organizations, with credibility in the boardroom and with operational teams.

* Proven ability to lead cross-functional execution across Product, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Marketing and Operations without formal authority over any of them.

* Strong commercial and analytical judgment. You measure what you own, keep one source of truth, and bring a number to every conversation.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, including material built for executive audiences.

* Fluency with AI-enabled productivity and automation tools (e.g., large language model interfaces, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval) to synthesize partner data, accelerate reporting, build playbooks, and improve go-to-market speed. Familiarity with core AI/ML concepts and the ability to evaluate AI-driven features in product and provide practical feedback.

Preferred requirements

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

* **They inspect boards.** An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.
* **They program robots.** Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.
* **They watch the factory.** They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.
* **They run the back office.** They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.
* **They write our code.** Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

## What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

## How we build

* **Evals first.** An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.
* **Agents judge, code writes.** Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.
* **Classical first, model second.** Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.
* **Safe by construction.** Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

## Recent work

* Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.
* A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.
* Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.
* Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.
* A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

## What we look for

* You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.
* You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.
* You build the eval before you trust the result.
* You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°.

Our ambition is to build a strong, sustainable and connected Women’s & Girls’ pathway which develops Worcestershire players, increases the depth and quality of our playing pool and provides a clear route from junior cricket into the senior Women’s team and, for those with the ambition and ability, into professional cricket.

**Purpose of the Role:**

The Head of Women’s & Girls’ Cricket will have overall responsibility and accountability for the direction, performance and development of Women’s & Girls’ cricket at Worcestershire County Cricket Club.

The role will provide leadership across the entire Worcestershire pathway, from the youngest age groups through to the Women’s senior team, ensuring there is a clear and connected approach to identifying, developing and progressing talented players.

A key part of the structure will be the line management and development of a dedicated lead for the younger age-group pathway, who will take day-to-day responsibility for coaching and programme delivery within those age groups. The Head of Women’s & Girls’ Cricket will retain overall accountability for the quality, direction and effectiveness of the whole pathway.

The role itself will have a significant hands-on coaching and performance focus, taking direct responsibility for the coaching, development, preparation and performance of the Women’s senior team and Under-18 programme.

Our ambition is to develop our own players, build a larger group capable of thriving at Tier 2 level and give our most talented and ambitious players the skills, experience and opportunity to progress into professional cricket. Success will therefore be measured not only by results, but by the strength, depth and progression of the Worcestershire player pathway.

The postholder will be responsible for establishing the cricketing philosophy, standards, culture and environment of the senior programme - creating a team that is ambitious, competitive, enjoyable to be part of and recognised for developing players.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

· Provide overall leadership, strategy and accountability for Worcestershire Women’s & Girls’ performance cricket and the complete player pathway.

· Act as Head Coach of the Worcestershire Women’s senior team, EPP and Under-18 programme, leading coaching, training, match preparation, selection, individual player development and performance.

· Establish and lead the culture, playing philosophy, standards and expectations of the senior Women’s programme.

· Develop individual players technically, tactically, physically and mentally, with a strong emphasis on helping players maximise their potential.

· Build greater depth within the Worcestershire playing pathway, increasing the number of players capable of progressing into and succeeding within the senior team.

· Create a clear and visible pathway from junior age-group cricket through U18s and into the senior Women’s team.

· Make the development of home-grown Worcestershire players a central objective of the programme, while appropriately supplementing the squad where necessary.

· Ensure talented players with the ambition and ability to progress beyond Tier 2 are prepared and supported to pursue opportunities within professional cricket.

· Line manage the junior player pathway lead (who will be responsible for the U16 squad and below), setting clear objectives and ensuring high-quality coaching, talent identification and player development throughout the programme.

· Maintain oversight of all age-group programmes and ensure consistency in coaching philosophy, standards, selection and player development across the pathway.

· Lead the identification, tracking and development of talented players and ensure appropriate individual development plans are in place.

· Maintain strong relationships with clubs, schools, partner counties, Tier 1 organisations and other relevant stakeholders to create the best possible development opportunities for Worcestershire players.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **About the role**

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Strategist to own our most strategic customer engagements - from first workshop through delivery. You'll sit with executive sponsors, surface the highest-value use cases, turn them into tightly scoped projects, then stay accountable for the outcome, working with the FDE.

You'll typically work in a pod of one Strategist and 1-2 FDEs. You own the executive relationship and the shape of delivery; the FDE embeds with the customer's team and owns the deeper production builds. You'll stay hands-on at the configuration layer week to week, including workflows, integrations, and platform tooling, partnering with the FDE where the build is most complex. You will translate technical build into business outcomes and own the adoption of the build.

This is for someone who combines technical credibility in agentic coding and LLMs with the executive presence to earn trust in the boardroom, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Scope**

  + Partner with customer executive sponsors to scope FDE projects — translating ambiguous business problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
  + Lead technical discovery and architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints to validate that every engagement is technically feasible

  **Deliver**

  + Work side by side with the FDE on the technical build — you own the configuration layer including workflows, settings, integrations, and platform tooling that don't require heavy custom code while the FDE owns the deeper production builds
  + Own technical enablement and adoption: run hands-on training, build playbooks and reference workflows, and coach the customer's team until they're self-sufficient. Adoption is measured by what their users do without you in the room
  + Monitor technical feasibility throughout delivery, adjusting scope with the sponsor when constraints emerge rather than letting engagements drift
  + Identify and scope expansion opportunities as they surface during delivery, in partnership with the account team
  + Escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
  + Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

  **Own the executive relationship**

  + Establish and maintain the executive relationship on your engagements, serving as the primary point of contact from kickoff through handoff
  + Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
  + Translate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions — for the sponsor and for the build team

### **You may be a fit if**

* You've spent 6+ years in Solutions Architecture, Deployment Strategy, technical consulting, or an Engagement Manager seat where you owned scoping and delivery with a technical team in AI-production workflows
* You understand agentic coding and LLMs well enough to hold your own with senior eng: how they behave in production, where they fail, and what a resilient workflow looks like (you don't need to be the person writing the production code)
* You're comfortable hands-on with Cursor workflows, integrations, and platform config, and can read enough Python / JS-TS to partner with an FDE
* You've shipped AI-native workflows past the prototype stage and can tell a real production constraint from a nice-to-have
* You can walk into an unfamiliar enterprise eng org, find the highest-leverage intervention fast, and scope something that delivers concrete value in weeks, not quarters
* You have the executive presence to own the C-suite relationship and the technical credibility to earn trust with their eng leads
* Domain depth in FSI, insurance, telecom, high-tech, healthcare/life sciences, or semiconductor is a strong plus

# Fast Track Specialist NDA File Handler

Are you ready to take your litigation skills to the next level? Join our team as a Fast Track Specialist File Handler and make an impact in a challenging, rewarding role.   
   
As a Specialist Handler you will handle litigated delegated and non-delegated motor instructions on behalf of key insurer clients as well as the MIB.

The successful candidate will work in a small team dedicated to dealing with cases involving indemnity issues, on behalf of the MIB and other UK's largest insurers and will report directly to the Team Leader in respect of day-to-day tasks. The team handle cases valued from £0-£150,000 in value.

It will be necessary for the candidate to be able to demonstrate an ability to impress the client with the extent of their legal knowledge as well as their understanding of the litigation process and provide clear unambiguous advice on the strategy for bringing a claim to its resolution. A clear view on both relevant case law and appropriate evidence will be necessary.

The successful candidate should therefore be able to recognise cases with a technical bias, e.g. whether the MIB is the correct party to pursue (having an understanding of the Uninsured Drivers and Untraced Drivers Agreement) or whether an Insurer is a contractual Insurer, RTA Insurer, or Article 75 Insurer, and what actions are required if the policyholder is a Claimant and there is a counterclaim be pursued. The successful candidate should have a good understanding of Part 7 litigation process and dispute resolution. There will also be claims involving multiple parties, as well as progression opportunities to handle more high valued multi-track value claims.

## Key Responsibilities

* Reviewing files, noting and abiding by Client Guidelines
* Knowledge of Part 7 litigation, the CPR Rules and Court procedures
* Formulating initial and ongoing Strategy, efficiently and effectively, having in mind the appropriate fee structure.
* Comply with SLA requirement and critical dates.
* Draft reports confirming Strategy and agreeing the most suitable approach with the client.
* Draft legal documents and comply with Court orders/deadlines
* Throughout the lifetime of a case, being aware of the overall spend on a claim, whether fixed fee or hourly rate.
* Undertaking negotiations with Third Party Solicitors
* Liaising with Insured and Insurers and Brokers where necessary
* Ensuring ‘actions’ are carried out as per Action Lists in Case Management System
* Undertaking Court Hearings
* Ensuring relevant tasks are delegated to the paralegals
* Accurately recording time and management information
* Accurately processing bills in accordance with Client Guidelines
* Ensuring files are kept within ISO 9001 guidelines
* To ensure compliance with the SRA Standards & Regulations

## Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

* Minimum of 18 months experience of handling litigated claims, including Part 7 claims.
* Sound and practical experience of handling Fast Track RTA litigated files is essential, with evidence of managing own case load and reporting skills
* Have an understanding of indemnity and/or the MIB would be beneficial.
* Reporting to, liaising with and meeting clients with a high level of professionalism.
* Drafting of legal documents, including defences, applications, witness statements, Part 35 Questions, Part 18 Questions

* A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* The ability to meet deadlines and work efficiently by managing time in a fast-paced environment.
* A Professional manner with the ability to build relationship internally and externally.
* Recognise when sensitivity and tact are required
* Identify key facts/issues and make early investigations and decisions to bring a case to a conclusion
* Follow work processes and keep to Strategy
* Ability to make decisions

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience of managing fixed fees whilst delivering quality
* Good telephone negotiation skills

If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

## **What sets us apart**

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

## **Meet the team behind this journey**

You will lead the Production Inference team — the group responsible for the systems that serve DeepL's language AI models reliably and efficiently at scale. We sit at the intersection of research-grade technical ambition and production-grade operational discipline: our work determines whether DeepL's models reach users with the latency, reliability, and cost profile that makes commercial deployment viable. The team owns the full model serving stack — from GPU-resident inference runtimes and deployment infrastructure through to the developer platform that enables every other research team to bring their models to production. We operate within the Research organisation, with close ties to DeepL's infrastructure and platform functions, and our architectural decisions affect every product DeepL ships. The broader Research organisation publishes regularly at ACL, NeurIPS, and EMNLP, and the Production Inference team brings that same culture of rigour and innovation to the systems layer of AI.

## **Your responsibilities**

As Engineering Manager for the Production Inference team, you will own both people leadership and technical direction for a team of research scientists and ML engineers working on performance-critical model serving systems. While this is not a hands-on coding role, you will be deeply involved in technical reviews, architecture decisions, and research direction for the inference stack.

You will:

* Lead and develop a high-performing team of research scientists and ML engineers, building strong development plans, fostering a candid and non-retaliatory feedback culture, and maintaining high standards of technical rigour and delivery.
* Own the team's research and development roadmap for production inference systems, in close collaboration with senior ICs and cross-functional stakeholders, balancing near-term reliability commitments with longer-horizon research bets on inference efficiency and architecture.
* Act as the primary technical interface between the Production Inference team and adjacent functions — including foundational models research, voice research, applied research, infrastructure, and product — ensuring research output is well-scoped, well-communicated, and delivered without creating downstream bottlenecks.

* Play an active role in identifying, assessing, and recruiting research and engineering talent as the team continues to develop.

Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.
Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.
Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.
Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.
Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.
Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.
Lead at a senior level, presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.

Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure.

A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use.
The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader.

A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone.

Real scale from day one. Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands.
Frontier work, real constraints. You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production.
Visible impact. Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company.

## Job description

**OTC Exotics Flow Support**

**London**

**12 Months Fixed Term Contract**

This is a flow support role supporting the OTC & equity derivative trading desks across vanilla and exotic products. This role sits as part of a larger ops team that also covers sales support.

The individual must be able to work harmoniously with their counterparts in an intense, deadline-driven environment, taking full ownership of tasks as they come in. The role is focused on the integrity of the book — ensuring trades are captured correctly, lifecycle and corporate action events are processed accurately, and breaks and exceptions are cleared before they reach risk or P&L. Frequent and proactive communication with the trading desk, downstream teams and Ops management is required to succeed in this role.

## Job requirements

**Key Responsibilities**

* A key requirement of this role is the ability to jump in on ongoing issues or exceptions, understand the root issue and own the coordination of it through to a timely resolution.
* Liaise with the desk and senior stakeholders across the teams network to respond to queries and resolve issues.
* Review and validate trade bookings across OTC vanilla and some exotic products, ensuring economics, static data and booking models are correct at the point of capture and that the risk system reflects the desk's intended position.
* Perform and review daily reconciliations across positions, trade populations, cash and collateral. Investigate breaks to root cause, coordinate the correcting action with the relevant team, and drive ageing items to resolution and closure.
* Own the daily exception queues, working on unmatched, unconfirmed and failing items. Prioritise by risk and client impact, escalate early where a resolution is at risk, and identify the recurring exceptions that warrant a permanent fix.
* Manage the operational impact of corporate actions on the derivatives book, including dividends, mergers, stock splits, spin-offs and rights issues. Coordinate contract adjustments with the desk, apply the resulting changes accurately in the risk system, and validate the outcome against expectation.
* Process expiries, exercises and assignments, barrier and knock-out events on exotic structures, resets and novations, ensuring the desk and downstream teams are aligned ahead of each event date.
* Resolve any matching, affirmation and tradeflow issues, working with counterparties and internal teams to clear breaks and improve straight-through processing rates.
* Act as the escalation point for settlement and cash breaks on the book, working with Settlements, Collateral and the counterparty to resolve issues before they age.
* Continually look for more efficient ways to run the daily control set, whether through defaulting logic, better use of STP models, automation of manual checks, or eliminating the causes of recurring breaks.

**Essential Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent: all analytical disciplines considered.
* Strong product knowledge across equity derivatives essential — experience with OTC vanilla and exotic options is beneficial and listed options and equity swaps also.
* Demonstrable experience of reconciliations, break investigation and exception management in a trade support or middle office environment.
* Practical understanding of corporate actions and their impact on derivative contracts.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the confidence to deal with senior internal clients and join a team of experienced professionals.
* Demonstration in their past work experience of robust analytical skills, high attention to detail, process improvement and a control mindset.
* A self-starter with the ability to work on their own initiative as well as be a solid team player.
* Comfortable working to hard intraday deadlines with the resilience to hold the line on controls under desk pressure.

DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day - and for our alarm signalling customers, that promise depends on hardware and software working together flawlessly. This role owns IoT and alarm signalling hardware integrations and device connectivity for DT ARC, bridging the gap between hardware and software to support new engineering requests as well as repair and manufacturing workflows.

Given the safety-critical nature of alarm signalling, this role needs a security-conscious approach and the confidence to troubleshoot issues that span both hardware and software.

As a specialist within the ARC development team who brings dedicated IoT experience, you will bridge the gap between physical hardware engineering and our operational monitoring platforms. Working alongside embedded firmware engineers, product managers, and software peers, you will ingest and map device telemetry, sensor feeds, and remote MQTT commands into our central Alarm Receiving Centre (ARC) platform and DTCommand client portal.

You will translate device-level hardware capabilities (such as geolocation) into intuitive, dependable controls and visual states for our 24/7 ARC operators. Furthermore, you will drive the iterative evolution of device features - progressing capabilities from basic on/off toggles and timed schedules through to smart, telemetry-driven automations and workflows.

**ABOUT DETERTECH**

DeterTech is a security technology company operating across six countries, with principal UK sites in Prestwick and Telford. We predict, deter and detect risk on behalf of the people and communities we serve. Our values - Committed, Inclusive and Ambitious - shape how we work every day: we are accountable and deliver excellence; we collaborate and build trust; and we never stop learning while winning in the right way.

*This is a remote role, with the flexibility to work from home. We also value face-to-face collaboration and would ask for some flexibility to attend occasional in-person meetings or team sessions.*

**1. IoT and hardware integration**

- Build and maintain software integrations with IoT and hardware devices, including alarm signalling equipment, sensors and gateways.

- Apply relevant signalling protocols and standards used in the alarm/ARC industry (for example SIA, Contact ID, IP signalling).

- Ingest, decode, and process device telemetry and command topics (via MQTT, WebSockets, and TCP/UDP sockets) published by embedded hardware and firmware engineering teams.

- Map raw device states, diagnostic health metrics, and sensor data into operational database schemas and real-time ARC monitoring views.

- Implement resilient bidirectional messaging pipelines to dispatch remote control commands, configuration updates, and firmware state synchronisations over cellular and IoT networks.

**2. Application development & iterative feature engineering**

- Build the software side of device integrations, APIs and monitoring using strong Laravel/PHP skills.

- Use MQTT or similar messaging protocols for device connectivity where appropriate.

- Implement responsive operator interfaces and control panels within the ARC platform and DTCommand, translating UI/UX wireframes, interactive prototypes, and design specs provided by the Lead Digital Product Designer into functional frontend components and backend APIs

- Drive the phased, iterative evolution of hardware features in close alignment with the Head of Product and Lead Digital Product Designer - progressing device commands from simple manual toggles to rule-based timed intervals, telemetry-driven thresholds, and machine-learning assisted automations.

- Architect and scale background queue consumers to process high-frequency device heartbeats, pings, and alarm events with minimal latency.

- Build and maintain secure RESTful and event-driven APIs connecting device management services with the core ARC platform, DTCommand client portal, and mobile applications.

**3. Troubleshooting and support**

- Troubleshoot issues across the hardware/software boundary, working with engineering, repair and manufacturing colleagues as needed.

- Partner closely with hardware and embedded firmware engineers to define clear interface contracts, payload schemas, and MQTT topic structures for emerging device revisions and product features.

- Develop diagnostic utilities and device provisioning scripts to empower manufacturing and repair technicians to test, flash, configure, and certify equipment efficiently.

- Investigate complex telemetry anomalies, packet dropouts, and handshake timeouts in collaboration with relevant teams.

- Provide tier-3 technical escalation support for live signalling faults, identifying whether root causes stem from firmware bugs, cellular network carriers, protocol decoding, or backend application logic and work with relevant teams to support and fix.

**4. Security, compliance and reliability**

- Apply a security-conscious approach to device connectivity, reflecting the critical, safety-related nature of alarm signalling.

- Implement strict security standards across all device communications, including transport encryption (TLS/mTLS), secure token/credential rotation, and mutual authentication.

- Ensure signalling architectures comply with alarm industry standards (such as BS EN 50131 / BS 5979 / PD 6662) and data privacy regulations (GDPR).

- Establish monitoring, synthetic health checks, and alerting on device listener sockets and broker connections to detect dropouts or network degradation proactively.

**5. Sprint delivery and platform collaboration**

- Participate actively in Agile sprint meeting with the Technical Delivery Manager, delivering predictable milestones on product engineering initiatives.

- Partner with the Lead Full Stack Developer for architectural guidance, code reviews, and API schema design to ensure IoT components integrate cleanly into the wider Laravel ecosystem.

- Collaborate closely with the Lead Digital Product Designer to review user interaction models, technical feasibility of UI components, and stateful feedback loops.

- Liaise with the MuleSoft / Integration team to ensure device information from manufacturing and repair configurations can be synchronised.

**Essential**

- Experience integrating software with IoT/hardware devices (for example alarm signalling equipment, sensors, gateways).

- Understanding of relevant signalling protocols/standards used in the alarm/ARC industry (for example SIA, Contact ID, IP signalling).

- Strong Laravel/PHP skills to build the software side of device integrations, APIs and monitoring.

- Comfortable troubleshooting issues across the hardware/software boundary.

- A security-conscious approach to device connectivity, given the critical nature of alarm signalling.

- Background developing web applications, microservices, or daemons in modern PHP/Laravel (including queue workers, and event broadcasting).

- Practical experience working with MQTT, WebSockets, or publish/subscribe messaging architectures for device connectivity and telemetry ingestion.

- Demonstrated ability to translate raw hardware sensor data (telemetry, environmental inputs, battery budgets) into functional software applications and clear visual states.

- Familiarity with appropriate databases and caching/queue technologies for high-volume event processing.

- Collaborative team player, comfortable working across disciplines with embedded firmware engineers, product managers, digital designers, and manufacturing/repair technicians.

**Desirable**

- Experience with MQTT or similar messaging protocols for device connectivity.

- Experience in the security, alarm or IoT hardware industry.

- Familiarity with frontend technologies commonly used in the Laravel ecosystem

Doctify is the global platform built by doctors for doctors, on a mission to build the largest, most trusted global network of validated healthcare providers and experts. We connect patients with the right doctors, and doctors with respected peers, to ensure better care worldwide. We do things differently here at Doctify, we are boldly leading a digital revolution in healthcare and are confident in our mission.

#### About The Role

The Senior SEO & GEO Optimisation Specialist is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role focused on how patients discover Doctify, whether they search on Google or ask an AI assistant. This dual-discipline role combines traditional Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) with Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).

Patients increasingly begin their care journey with a question: “Who is the best knee surgeon near me?” or “Which dermatologist in Dubai has the best reviews?” You will help make sure Doctify’s specialist, clinic and hospital profiles, specialty and location pages, and health content are the trusted answer, both in classic search results (Google, Bing) and in Large Language Models and AI search experiences (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews).

Technical SEO is the foundation of this role. You will turn our organic strategy into delivered results, owning priority markets, page types and workstreams end to end. You will work day to day with Product, Engineering, Data, Content and Commercial teams to ship improvements and measure their impact.

#### You’ll be responsible for

##### **Technical SEO**

* Platform Health: Monitor and improve the technical health of a large, multi-market site with many practitioner, clinic and hospital profiles: rendering (JavaScript SEO), Core Web Vitals, crawl budget, indexation, faceted search and internal linking.
* Programmatic & Local SEO: Optimise templated specialty × location × treatment pages so they are useful, avoid thin or duplicate content, and win in local and map-pack results.
* Schema & Structured Data: Implement and maintain structured data (e.g. Physician, Medical Clinic, Hospital, Medical Specialty, Reviews) that connects practitioners, organisations, specialties and verified reviews, in line with search engine guidelines.
* Engineering Collaboration: Write clear SEO tickets and requirements, QA releases and migrations, and support new market launches with Product and Engineering.

* Dual-Engine Growth Delivery: Turn Doctify’s organic strategy into quarterly roadmaps and deliver projects that grow patient traffic, bookings and review volume across your assigned markets, balancing SEO and AI-search discoverability.
* Search Landscape Awareness: Track Google algorithm updates (especially YMYL, E-E-A-T and helpful-content changes) and developments in AI answer engines. Assess their impact on Doctify and recommend responses.
* Keyword & Intent Research: Research patient intent across specialties, conditions, treatments, procedures and locations. Build content-gap and “query fan-out” analyses that link these journeys to the right Doctify pages.
* International Support: Support organic launches in new and growing markets, including localised keyword research, hreflang implementation and multilingual QA (e.g. English, German, Arabic).

##### **Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) & AI Discoverability**

* AI Citation Growth: Run initiatives that increase how often, and how accurately, Doctify, our specialists and our verified review data are cited in AI-generated answers to healthcare questions.
* Trust-First Content Structuring: Work with Content and Client Success teams to structure profiles, review summaries and health content so AI models can ingest them accurately, with clear authorship, medical review and sourcing.
* Accuracy & Brand Safety: Monitor how AI engines describe Doctify and the providers on our platform. Flag outdated or wrong information and drive fixes, recognising the higher stakes of health-related answers.
* GEO Measurement: Run and maintain the tools that track share-of-voice, sentiment and citation frequency in AI search. Report trends against healthcare directories and competitors.

##### **Workflows & Tooling**

* SEO Automation: Build scripts and AI-assisted workflows for page-quality checks, metadata generation, profile completeness audits and content testing across tens of thousands of pages.
* Monitoring & Alerting: Set up and maintain dashboards and alerts that flag volatility in rankings, indexation and AI search visibility by market and specialty.
* Performance Reporting: Report organic performance against business outcomes such as patient sessions, bookings and review submissions, and share clear insights with the team and stakeholders.

##### **Compliance & Trust**

* Responsible Healthcare Marketing: Make sure SEO and GEO work respects healthcare advertising and data rules (e.g. ASA/CAP Code, GDPR/UK GDPR and equivalent rules in each market), and never compromises the integrity of verified reviews.
* E-E-A-T Best Practice: Apply clinical accuracy, transparent authorship and medical review standards so Doctify is seen as a trustworthy source of healthcare provider information.

##### **Team Contribution**

* Knowledge Sharing: Share SEO and GEO best practice with Content, Product and market teams, and support more junior colleagues where needed.
