It makes debt, and equity, investments in the power sector, predominantly focusing on renewable power generation projects as well as electricity storage, transmission and distribution projects working with both public sector clients as well as private sponsors. Its activities are subject to the applicable Energy Sector Strategy and the Green Economy Transition Approach and consistent with the EBRD’s commitment to aligning its activities with the goals of the Paris Agreement. It also plays a key role in advancing policy dialogue to promote green, competitive and liberalised energy markets, with a particular focus on the development of regulatory frameworks to support increased penetration of renewable energy.

The Principal Banker is competent in undertaking all tasks related to, and understands all aspects of, project development and implementation, including project origination, structuring, execution, implementation and monitoring, for all types of investment instruments offered by the Bank.

The Principal Banker will act both as a senior member of a project team or as the Operational Leader (OL) / Transaction Leader leading the processing of an EBRD investment operation.

The Principal Banker, in their role as an operation leader, is expected to take responsibility for effective leadership of their project team/s, supervision of junior banking staff, while contributing to their coaching and providing mentoring assistance, as required.

The Principal Banker’s role also includes elements of business/pipeline development, client management and policy dialogue.

***Please note that we are recruiting for two vacancies through this selection process: one regular role and one short-term(23 months) contract role.***

**Background**

The Project life-cycle involves several stages from origination to signing, followed by implementation and monitoring until full completion and repayment or exit. All the stages involve different tasks such as business marketing, project due diligence analysis, structuring and approval, negotiation and signing of project agreements, disbursement and monitoring.

The role of the Principal Banker is to contribute, as a senior project team member, to the structuring, implementation and monitoring of complex transactions, and to lead, as an operation leader, the development of less complex debt and equity transactions, and the effective implementation and monitoring of an assigned number of portfolio projects, in line with the Bank’s operational objectives.  The Principal Banker supervises, both as senior team member and as operation leader, more junior colleagues to ensure efficient processing of deal flow and portfolio monitoring.

The Principal Banker is able to build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders in relation to business development, project execution, implementation and monitoring, policy dialogue, co-financing arrangements and donor funding, as applicable.

A substantial degree of independence is given to the Principal Banker, and they are expected to ensure effective project team work and progressively take on overall responsibility for increasingly complex transactions.

**Accountabilities & Responsibilities**

1.       Structuring and Execution

* Work as a senior project team member with more experienced operation leaders on complex transactions, contributing to all aspects of project structuring and execution, including supporting the operation leader with the management of the project team;  
  As an operation leader:
* Lead structuring, negotiation (including review of legal documentation) and the execution of transactions, working with clients, authorities, consultants and internal units;
* Manage the resources and the work load of the project teams under their supervision;
* Oversee the project due diligence process ensuring it meets the Bank’s standards;
* Ensure quality and appropriateness of technical cooperation (TC) assistance components which support the investments or contribute to policy dialogue initiatives;
* Ensure that all transactions within their responsibility are completed within the specified time frames to a high standard (including all internal memoranda and Board reports) and in line with the policies, procedures and objectives of the Bank.

2.       Portfolio Monitoring, Value Creation and Reporting

* As a senior project team member perform all such tasks as may be assigned by the operation leader and provide constructive portfolio monitoring advice, guidance and supervision to more junior members of the project team.  
  As operation leader:
* Take overall responsibility for the effective monitoring of all projects within their responsibility, including verifying the quality of regular monitoring reports; taking the lead in maintaining or supervising the management of client relationships; actively managing the resolution of any implementation/monitoring issues in cooperation with relevant Portfolio Managers; managing and supervising more junior bankers who assist in portfolio monitoring;
* Supervise implementation and monitoring of, and reporting on, relevant TC assignments to ensure their compliance with donor reporting requirements, operational objectives and that all reports are of a high quality;
* Take responsibility for ensuring timely notification of any critical portfolio issues to the relevant Portfolio Manager and/or Management, ensuring availability of adequate data and information for the Portfolio Manager and/or Management to be able to take timely decisions.

3.       Policy Dialogue

* In cooperation with relevant units within the Bank (e.g., CSD, PSD, Impact) and Banking country teams (if applicable), contribute to policy dialogue, in a leading role (project level initiatives) or supporting function (national level initiatives);
* Assist in providing necessary support, in the form of relevant information or documentation or meeting participation, towards efforts to procure grants and technical cooperation funds to complement investment projects or required as part of policy dialogue efforts.

4.       Business Development

* Assist with marketing and business development efforts in the relevant sector and countries to build reputable market contacts in order to develop a broad deal flow and cross selling of the Bank’s competencies;
* Assist with the critical screening of project proposal flow that is generated through business development efforts, liaising with other colleagues and teams within the Bank to identify sound and executable investments that meet the mandate of the Bank.

5.       Staff Management

* Assist in recruiting, training, coaching and mentoring junior bankers, in coordination with the team Director and Associate Directors, Senior Bankers, involving them in all aspects of the project cycle (appraisal, execution, implementation, monitoring and business development), ensuring adequate quality of project work  and appropriate work load distribution amongst the project team members; contribute to  their professional and competency development;
* Develop productive relationships within the organisation to able to work effectively in a country/sector matrix structure and in a multi-cultural working environment.
* Directly accountable for the engagement and effective overall management of the Team including recruitment, compensation, performance management, coaching and development. Where matrix reporting is in place, work jointly with the country counterpart when setting objectives and completing performance appraisals for relevant staff.
* Champion and role model the Bank’s Behavioural Competencies and Corporate Behaviours, ensuring adherence within the team(s) so that the highest standards of integrity and ethical conduct are exhibited at all times.

The responsibilities of the Principal Banker are designed to allow for the development of transaction expertise and expansion of responsibilities, leading to assuming the role of Senior Banker.

**Qualifications & Skills / Experience & Knowledge**

Qualifications and Skills:

* Bachelor’s degree.  Master’s degree preferred or equivalent experience in the areas of expertise.
* Professional qualification such as ACA, CFA, ACCA, or CIMA desirable.
* Strong quantitative/numerical skills are critical with the ability to interpret financial information and to design and use financial models.
* Credit analysis skills, with the ability to interpret accounts, understanding local and international accounting principles and practice of credit analysis.
* Computer literacy, conversant with Microsoft Office and spread sheet packages including financial analysis and modelling modules.
* Excellent understanding of relevant systems and processes.
* Stakeholder management skills.
* Coaching, mentoring & leadership skills.
* Relationship management and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work to deadlines and under time pressure.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
* Good command over the local/country language(s) is an advantage.

Experience & Knowledge:

* Significant relevant financial industry experience from an investment or commercial bank, private equity firm, asset management firm, international financial institution, or auditing/financial consulting firm operating to international standards.
* Practical experience of participating in and leading complex transactions through the full project life cycle.
* Relevant energy sector experience.
* Understanding of energy markets dynamics and new technological trends (e.g. digitalisation, energy storage, hydrogen).

**What is it like to work at the EBRD? / About EBRD**

Our agile and innovative approach is what makes life at the EBRD a unique experience! You will be part of a pioneering and diverse international organisation, and use your talents to make a real difference to people's lives and help shape the future of the regions we invest in.  

At EBRD, our Values – Inclusiveness, Innovation, Trust, and Responsibility – are at the heart of how we work. We bring these to life through our Workplace Behaviours: listening well and speaking up, collaborating smartly, acting decisively with full commitment, and simplifying to amplify our impact. These principles shape our culture and define our success. We seek individuals who not only share these values but are also committed to embedding them in their daily work, fostering a positive and high-performing environment. 

The EBRD environment provides you with:

* A working culture that embraces inclusion and celebrates diversity. Our workforce reflects a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, bringing fresh ideas, energy, and innovation and enhancing our ability to serve our clients, shareholders, and counterparties effectively.
* A hybrid workplace that offers flexibility to teams and individuals; that is based on trust, flexibility and connectedness.

As such, the EBRD seeks to ensure that everyone is treated with respect and given equal opportunities and works in an inclusive environment. About Ethos
Ethos is a collaborative team of engineers, consultants, and creative thinkers designing and delivering data centre and energy infrastructure across the world's most dynamic markets. As a multidisciplinary consultancy, we combine technical expertise, creativity, and integrated delivery to lead complex, mission-critical projects.
Built on strong relationships, clear leadership, and a can-do mindset, Ethos is entering an exciting phase of growth, expanding our capabilities and taking on increasingly high-impact projects across EMEA and beyond.
Sustainability guides how we design, collaborate, and deliver, creating innovative solutions and lasting value for our clients and communities — making Performance Made Possible.
About the Job
As a Senior Project Engineer – Electrical, you will play a key role within Ethos’ Data Centre Retrofit area, supporting the delivery of complex upgrades across mission-critical data centre environments.
You will lead the design, specification and delivery of electrical systems, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest technical standards. Working within live environments, you will help maintain continuity of operations while delivering high-quality engineering solutions.
This role will also involve managing project delivery, mentoring junior engineers and acting as a key technical point of contact for clients and contractors across major European data centre markets.
Responsibilities:
Lead the design and delivery of electrical building services upgrades within live data centre environments, including M&E upgrades, capacity increases, technology refreshes, phased refurbishments, and lifecycle replacements.
Develop and manage retrofit-specific design strategies, including tie-ins to live systems, redundancy planning, outage and staging strategies, and resilience design.
Conduct or oversee technical due diligence of existing data centre facilities, including capacity unlock assessments (power, cooling, and white space).
Prepare and review detailed design drawings, schematics, schedules, technical reports, and tender documentation.
Manage project scope, budget, programme, and contracts — identifying and mitigating scope creep, risks, and live-environment constraints.
Liaise directly with clients (hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise operators), contractors, and vendors to ensure project goals are achieved with zero operational disruption.
Drive quality assurance and governance across all assigned projects, adhering to WAP/PTW protocols in live environments.
Mentor and support the development of junior engineers and graduate staff within the retrofit workstream.
Support business development by contributing to proposals, client presentations, and technical strategies for retrofit opportunities across EMEA.
Champion innovation in live-environment engineering and contribute to the continuous improvement of Ethos’ retrofit delivery model.
Lead electrical system tie-in strategies for live power distribution upgrades, including UPS changeovers, busbar modifications, and generator integration in operational environments.
About You
Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
Minimum 8 years’ experience in building services engineering, with at least 3 years focused on data centre or mission-critical projects.
Demonstrable experience working in live, operational data centre environments — including brownfield upgrades, M&E replacements, or phased refurbishments.
Chartered Engineer status (or actively working towards Chartership) with Engineers Ireland or equivalent.
Proven track record managing multi-million-euro MEP projects from concept to completion.
Strong understanding of EU building regulations; knowledge of LEED/BREEAM and the EU Energy Efficiency Directive is an advantage.
Familiarity with BMS/EPMS integration and smart building systems within mission-critical environments is advantageous.
Technical Skills
Proven expertise in electrical building services design for live data centre environments, including LV/MV power distribution, UPS systems, standby generation, busbar upgrades, and life safety systems.
Experience delivering electrical upgrades within operational mission-critical facilities — including live switchgear replacements, UPS changeovers, and phased distribution upgrades.
Strong working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit MEP, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Office; experience with ETAP, Amtech, or DIALux for calculations.
Excellent understanding of IEC, CIBSE, BS, IS, and EN standards applied to retrofit and live-environment projects.
Experience producing single-line diagrams, schematics, and technical drawings for complex electrical retrofit scopes.
Familiarity with commissioning, power system coordination studies, and compliance documentation for live data centre upgrades.
Soft Skills
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence in client-facing settings.
Strong organisational and problem-solving abilities, capable of managing multiple concurrent retrofit projects.
Collaborative approach to working across multidisciplinary teams including mechanical, electrical, sustainability, and BIM disciplines.
Proactive, detail-oriented mindset with a sharp focus on risk management and technical quality in live environments.
Calm under pressure — able to make sound engineering decisions within constrained, operational environments.
Why Join Us?
Join collaborative leaders – Work alongside experienced, approachable professionals who
combine technical excellence with calm, supportive leadership.
Make a real impact – Contribute to mission-critical infrastructure projects that support the digital and energy transition across EMEA and beyond.
Grow with us – As a rapidly growing consultancy, we offer opportunities to develop your skills, broaden your experience, and build your career.
Shape a more sustainable future – Sustainability isn't an initiative—it's embedded in every project, every discipline, and every decision we make.

We offer:
Flexible Fridays and a 9-day fortnight working schedule — enjoy every second Friday off to maintain work–life balance.
A culture that values flexibility, learning, and teamwork, with clear progression pathways and support toward professional accreditation.
Opportunities to work alongside some of the most experienced engineers in the industry, within a forward-thinking, technology-driven consultancy.

Flexible working times
25 Days holidays

Refer a Friend scheme
Subsidised Health Insurance Allowance
Working travel out-of-pocket expenses
Regular training/mentoring / further college support
Support for Chartership
A Professional Subscription Fee paid by the company

Heavily subsidised social committee

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.

## **What role you will play on our team**

Join a high performing Front Office Valuation and Structuring quant team supporting Gas and Power trading, asset optimization and structured transactions. You will provide transparent, independent and commercially actionable valuation expertise, with a strong focus on identifying, modelling and pricing embedded physical and financial optionality across storages, swing contracts, transportation/pipeline capacity and power generation assets.

Your work will support traders, originators and senior stakeholders in evaluating structured supply/offtake agreements, capacity deals, dispatch linked structures and cross commodity strategies, while contributing to global corporate initiatives requiring rigorous valuation, optionality analysis and risk translation beyond the core Trading organization.

## **What you will do**

* Provide fair valuation and independent risk assessment for gas storage, swing options, pipeline capacity rights, load following structures and power asset linked deals, quantifying operational, volume, flexibility and market optionality.
* Support traders and originators with structure design, including exercise rules, dispatch/flow logic, strike/index formulas, exposure mapping, sensitivities and commercial explanation of optionality value drivers.
* Build valuation templates and analytics tools capable of modelling storage injection/withdrawal optimization, swing flexibility, dispatch optionality and capacity arbitrage, using stochastic, scenario based and optimisation techniques.
* Contribute optionality and valuation insight to large global corporate projects, such as long term gas supply frameworks, optimization of cross border capacity, and power asset commercialisation initiatives.
* Advise on hedging strategies for complex exposures across gas hubs (NBP, TTF, Henry Hub), power markets, capacity rights and cross commodity structures, identifying hedgeable and residual components.
* Conduct back testing, assumption validation and parameter research, including calibration of illiquid curves, volatility structures, correlation frameworks and dispatch driven price dynamics.
* Collaborate with quant modelling/technology/data teams to ensure robust model deployment, integration into FO tools, and support for asset optimisation workflows.

## **What you bring**

* Strong quantitative background (MSc/PhD preferred) with Front Office Gas & Power valuation/structuring or optimisation experience.
* Expertise in storage modelling, swing option valuation, pipeline/transport optionality, and power asset/dispatch optionality, alongside strong option pricing and curve/vol modelling skills.
* Advanced Python for pricing tools, optimisation routines and scalable analytics.
* Ability to communicate complex optimisation and valuation logic clearly to traders and commercial teams.

* Understanding of gas hubs, power markets, capacity auctions, congestion patterns, spark/dark spreads, and operational constraints across pipes and generation assets.
* High attention to detail, strong documentation discipline and a proactive improvement mindset.

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

Explore a career at Fitch Ratings and you’ll join a collaborative network of curious minds. Here, our differences are our strengths - in life as well as our work. Together we work with integrity and objectivity to provide clarity to the world’s financial markets. We pride ourselves on our ability to harness the ideas, expertise, and professionalism of our global workforce, which is integral to our continued success. The accessibility and depth of experience of our industry leading analysts, combined with our broad sector credentials, allow us to help market participants make important credit decisions with confidence.

**Fitch Ratings’ Business Relationship Management (BRM) group is seeking a Market Research Associate. This role will be based in Canary Wharf, London, at our joint global headquarters office.**

The corporate BRM team is responsible for expanding Fitch’s rating coverage across the Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) region by generating new issuer and debt rating mandates and developing the existing portfolio of corporate ratings.

This position will support the business development and marketing efforts of senior relationship managers by helping them leverage relationships with decision-makers at corporate entities, as well as intermediaries at investment banks, private equity sponsors and debt advisory firms.

**About the Team**

* A varied role working across multiple industry sectors, geographies and rating categories
* Career development opportunities in business development, relationship management and marketing, with exposure to highly experienced senior decision-makers
* Access to high-quality training, learning and development opportunities

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Support senior team members in developing and executing frontline marketing plans to generate new rating mandates and advance existing relationship development plans
* Build knowledge of core business development data and create marketing materials, including pitchbooks, case studies, tombstones, pricing studies, corporate coverage slides and specialist technical content
* Develop in-depth knowledge of an industry sector to generate persuasive new marketing ideas
* Work with senior team members to research and identify new transaction-driven rating opportunities
* Use online platforms to monitor market activity and trends that support marketing messages
* Download and manage large datasets in Excel
* Keep marketing materials up to date
* Prioritise workflows and adapt to changing deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail

* A degree-level education; a finance or business-related subject would be advantageous
* Experience preparing marketing or business development materials using PowerPoint
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with demonstrable experience researching, analysing and interpreting large datasets
* Experience using client relationship management systems, such as Salesforce, and generating reports
* Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills
* Ability to work independently, with supervision and guidance from senior team members
* Proficiency in foreign languages may be beneficial

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Financial industry experience gained through exposure to debt capital markets, banking, corporate finance or credit analysis
* Knowledge of online platforms such as Bloomberg, FactSet and Dealogic
* Team-oriented, with the confidence to build effective relationships
* Enthusiastic and willing to learn

* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals

* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Inclusive Work Environment**: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

**Network Architect**

We’re looking for an accomplished Network Architect to join our Scalable Tech Team at Genomics England and provide technical leadership for the secure, resilient connectivity that underpins our technology platform, healthcare, research and corporate services.

Our network services connect cloud platforms (primarily AWS) and on-premise infrastructure, enabling clinicians, researchers and colleagues to access sensitive genomic and associated health data securely and reliably.

Working within the Technology and Product Directorate, you’ll shape and deliver Genomics England’s network architecture across AWS, hybrid connectivity, corporate locations and partner integrations. You’ll collaborate with infrastructure, cloud platform, security, engineering, procurement, commercial, service management and delivery colleagues to turn complex operational and user needs into coherent, cost-effective, scalable and secure network solutions.

This is an architecture role where you’ll balance longer-term network strategy with practical delivery. Drawing on your proven experience as an Architect, you will guide teams through network architecture decisions, develop reusable standards and patterns, and ensure solutions align with Genomics England’s wider technology strategy, architecture standards, security requirements and service expectations.

The scale and sensitivity of genomics require high-performing, highly available networks. AWS is at the heart of our environment, alongside hybrid and third-party connectivity, supporting secure data transfer, high-performance compute, large-scale storage, research workflows, operational services and controlled access to sensitive data.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture and design of network solutions across Genomics England, ensuring they are secure, scalable, cost-effective, resilient, supportable and aligned with organisational needs. Define target architectures, standards and reusable patterns for cloud, hybrid, remote-access and partner connectivity.
* Design and govern AWS networking, including multi-account connectivity, VPC design, routing, segmentation, private connectivity, DNS, load balancing and network security controls. Architect resilient connectivity between AWS, Genomics England locations, NHS and government partners, research organisations, suppliers and other trusted environments.
* Work with security colleagues to embed zero-trust principles, least privilege, network segmentation, secure remote access, encryption in transit and effective boundary protection. Ensure network designs support the secure movement and processing of large-scale genomic and associated health data, including high-throughput and latency-sensitive workloads.
* Develop network roadmaps and transition architectures that balance strategic direction, technical debt, service continuity and delivery priorities. Provide architectural oversight from discovery and options analysis through implementation, migration and live service.
* Document network architectures, traffic flows, trust boundaries, technical options, decisions, dependencies and transition states clearly for technical and non-technical audiences. Define requirements for network observability, performance monitoring, capacity management, configuration control, resilience testing and incident response.
* Collaborate with cloud platform, infrastructure, engineering, security, service management and delivery teams to ensure designs can be implemented and operated effectively. Contribute to architecture governance and assurance, presenting network designs and recommendations through appropriate technical forums.
* Identify network risks, constraints, dependencies and single points of failure early, working with teams to address them. Evaluate emerging networking technologies and managed services where they could improve security, performance, resilience, operability or cost-effectiveness.
* Work with architects across Genomics England to create coherent end-to-end solutions and encourage appropriate reuse across services. Contribute to architecture best practice and improving the quality of architecture across Genomics England.

**Skills and Experience for Success**

* Substantial experience designing and delivering enterprise network architectures in complex, security-conscious environments, with strong knowledge of AWS networking services and patterns, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPN, Route 53, load balancing, private endpoints and network security controls.
* Experience designing hybrid and multi-site connectivity, routing, switching, segmentation, firewalls, DNS, IP address management, load balancing and secure remote access. Detailed knowledge of physical network technology, ideally Cisco, NVIDIA and Mellanox, and in-depth understanding of Cisco Nexus Dashboard, data centre fabrics, Aruba networking infrastructure, BGP, OSPF, RoCE v2, performance optimisation and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting highly available and resilient networks with clear recovery objectives, diverse connectivity and tested failover arrangements. Strong understanding of network security architecture, zero-trust principles, defence in depth, trust boundaries and secure connectivity to third parties.
* Experience designing networks for high-throughput, data-intensive or latency-sensitive workloads and diagnosing performance or capacity constraints. Good understanding of automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, observability and operational support for modern networks.
* Ability to translate business, security, operational and user needs into practical network designs, standards and delivery roadmaps, balancing strategic architectural direction with immediate delivery needs, legacy constraints and service continuity.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and building alignment across architecture, infrastructure, cloud, engineering, security, procurement, commercial, service management and delivery stakeholders. Strong stakeholder engagement and a collaborative approach that builds trust and supports effective decision-making.
* Experience documenting and communicating network architectures, traffic flows, options, risks and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, and providing architectural governance and assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Ability to identify where network architecture practices, standards or controls could be improved and to embed those improvements into regular use.

**Desirable Skills and Experience**

* Relevant professional certification, such as AWS Advanced Networking, AWS Solutions Architect, Cisco CCNP/CCIE or an equivalent qualification.
* Experience working in healthcare, genomics, research, government or another regulated environment handling sensitive data, and experience in procurement processes associated with network infrastructure in a UK government organisation.
* Experience with software-defined networking, SD-WAN, secure access service edge, network access control or zero-trust network access. Knowledge of AWS Network Firewall, Cloud WAN, VPC Lattice, Gateway Load Balancer and related network security or connectivity services.
* Experience designing connectivity for high-performance compute, large-scale storage, data transfer appliances or distributed data-processing environments, and integrating with NHS, government, academic, research or commercial partner networks.
* Knowledge of network telemetry and tooling, including flow logs, packet analysis, synthetic monitoring, performance analytics and security monitoring.
* Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, automation and policy as code for network services.
* Understanding of identity-aware networking, certificate services, encryption, proxies, web gateways and data-loss prevention controls.
* Experience contributing to architecture governance forums such as a Technical Design Authority, familiarity with enterprise architecture tools such as Abacus, and experience applying TOGAF or equivalent architecture practices.

If you’re an experienced Network Architect who enjoys solving complex connectivity and security challenges, this is an exciting opportunity to shape the secure, resilient networks spanning AWS, on-premises infrastructure and partner environments that support life-changing genomic healthcare and research at Genomics England.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

**About Grafana Labs:**

There are more than 700,000 active installations of Grafana around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a SpaceX launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps companies including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay manage their observability strategies with full-stack offerings that can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud, or self-managed with Grafana Enterprise Stack. The Grafana stack has grown to include more open-source projects, including Grafana Loki (for logs) and Grafana Tempo (for traces) and Grafana Mimir (for metrics).

**Description of Duties**

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Writer to create documentation and learning content that helps people adopt and master Grafana’s observability products. You’ll work with engineers, product managers, and the Grafana writing team to produce content for a range of products and audiences, from first-time users to experienced practitioners. Because our products and priorities evolve, we’re looking for someone who learns new technical domains quickly.

AI is part of how this team works. We use AI-assisted workflows and tools throughout the content lifecycle, from research and drafting to review, validation, and maintenance. You’ll use these tools every day and help the team get better at using them.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, research, write, and maintain documentation and learning content (concepts, tasks, tutorials, references, and in-product learning) that supports adoption and long-term product mastery.
* Use AI tools and workflows to work faster and at a higher quality: drafting, structuring, technical validation, consistency checks, and keeping content current. You apply human judgment to everything AI produces and take responsibility for its accuracy.
* Contribute to the team’s shared AI workflows and skills, and look for ways to improve and automate how we create and maintain content as tools and models evolve.
* Partner with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders to understand product requirements, interview subject matter experts, and turn complex technical detail into clear, accurate content.
* Test what you document. Run the software, follow your own procedures, and flag product and UX gaps you find along the way.
* Let data guide your priorities. We have strong docs and learning analytics. You’ll use them, along with user feedback, to find content gaps, prioritize your work, and show the impact of what you ship.
* Work with the documentation manager and other writers to improve information architecture, voice, and consistency across our docs, and to make information easy to find for both people and AI-driven search and assistants.
* Manage several projects at once, using judgment to prioritize and communicate clearly when the plan changes.
* Mentor teammates and share practices that raise the quality of the team’s work.

**Requirements**

What experience would make someone be successful in this role?

* Experience writing or documenting enterprise or developer-facing software, with a portfolio or writing samples that show technical depth.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools and models in your writing workflow (such as LLM assistants, agentic coding tools, or custom prompts and skills), and the ability to explain how you evaluate and verify their output.
* Experience working with docs-as-code: command-line Git, GitHub (pull requests and reviews), Markdown, and common IDEs.
* Comfort working in technical environments. You can set up, run, and troubleshoot software yourself to verify what you write (for example, command line, containers, or Kubernetes, or a willingness to learn quickly).
* Experience collaborating with engineers and product managers to get accurate technical information.
* Experience working remotely and asynchronously on a distributed team.

**What you’ll bring to the role**

# Infrastructure Engineer (ML Compute) - London

## Location

Hybrid London; Hybrid Paris

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Hybrid

## Department

Engineering

OverviewApplication

You’ll own the GPU compute that powers our model training, evaluation and serving systems.

This role sits in our Infrastructure team, which works at the lowest layers of our stack, from Kubernetes down to the GPU hardware. You’ll run the clusters, GPUs and schedulers that our research, product and platform teams depend on, and manage the capacity we buy from our cloud providers.

## What success looks like

Success is measured by how well we use our GPUs: keeping production reliable and improving the performance of our training and serving stack.

## What you’ll be doing

* Running Kubernetes clusters for GPU training and inference
* Improving how GPU work is scheduled and placed
* Detecting, draining and repairing unhealthy GPU nodes
* Managing capacity with our cloud providers
* Debugging failures in GPUs, Linux, storage and networking

## The first year

By month 3, you’ll be handling a share of cluster incidents on your own and will have shipped one change to scheduling or node health, such as automatically detecting and draining unhealthy GPU nodes. By month 6, you’ll own one part of the compute layer outright: scheduling and placement, node health and repair, or capacity and new regions. By month 12, you’ll be responsible for a globally distributed GPU system that shifts capacity between training and inference as needs change.

## Who you’ll work with

Your hiring manager is our VP of Engineering. Day to day, you’ll work with the Platform Infrastructure team, the research and product teams who use our compute, and our cloud providers and other vendors.

## What we think it takes

**You’re likely a good fit if you:**

* Have built and run GPU workloads on Kubernetes
* Could design a GPU cluster for training and online RL from scratch
* Debug confidently at the OS layer and below (Linux, GPU drivers, networking and storage)
* Write strong Python

**It’s a plus if you’ve worked as an SRE or infrastructure engineer, or have used:**

* Slurm
* Kubernetes scheduling and autoscaling tools such as Kueue or Karpenter
* Multi-cloud orchestration tools such as SkyPilot
* AWS services such as EKS or SageMaker HyperPod
* High-performance interconnects and collective communication libraries such as EFA, InfiniBand, NCCL or Open MPI
* Terraform

You don’t need ML research experience. If you match most of this but not every point, please apply.

## How we hire

Four stages, about three hours in total: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute coding interview, a 60-minute system design interview and a closing 30-minute conversation with our VP of Engineering. The coding and system design interviews are modelled on real-world problems you’d face in this role.

## Practicalities

The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Paris or London office and occasional travel between the two. We offer a competitive package.

## Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

## The role

As a Talent Operations Partner based in Munich, you will work closely with the wider Talent Operations team to support the scheduling engine that keeps our hiring pipelines moving at pace. Interviews span multiple time zones, high volumes of candidates, and fast-moving hiring loops, and you will help turn that complexity into a smooth, well-coordinated process. Your work directly shapes the candidate experience and the speed at which specialists join the teams building our technological advantage in defence AI. By bringing precision and structure to high-volume, multi-region scheduling, you will make a tangible and measurable contribution to how quickly and effectively we secure the talent we need.

## The day-to-day

* Support high-volume interview scheduling across multiple time zones, working with the wider Talent Operations team to balance candidate, interviewer, and hiring manager availability at pace
* Operate Applicant Tracking Systems and automated scheduling tools to manage complex, fast-moving interview loops for virtual and onsite candidates
* Act as a key point of contact for candidates and interviewers, ensuring rapid response times and a seamless experience
* Maintain accurate, real-time data, documentation, and templates across all internal systems to support quick decision-making
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and Talent Operations colleagues to identify scheduling bottlenecks and implement measurable improvements to throughput and turnaround time
* Contribute to reporting on scheduling speed, pipeline velocity, and interview completion rates to track operational performance
* Be based in our Munich or London office, minimum 3 days per week

## You should apply if you

* Have supported a scaling, high-volume talent acquisition function with a focus on operational execution
* Manage complex, multi-time-zone scheduling with precision, even when priorities shift quickly
* Communicate clearly and can articulate process challenges to propose practical, fast-turnaround solutions
* Use Applicant Tracking Systems proficiently to increase team efficiency and throughput
* Solve problems in the moment to keep fast-paced pipelines moving without losing accuracy
* Are business fluent in German and English, and adapt effectively to a scaling, high-volume environment while maintaining confidentiality

*Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* *under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*

## Nice to Have

* Operational experience using Greenhouse, Ashby, Confluence, and GoodTime
* Data-focused approach, with the ability to manage and interpret reports relating to process efficiency

## Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

## **What the Project Is About**

Data centres are becoming some of Europe's most consequential and fastest-growing electricity users, yet most still appear to the grid as large, opaque, and largely grid-agnostic loads. AIRCAS, short for **AI-driven Resource & Cooling forCASting and control for data centres**, gives you the opportunity to change this through advanced AI control in a live data-centre environment. You will help build a digital twin, forecasting, and safety-constrained control system that coordinates electricity demand, cooling, heat recovery, and water use.

At HPE Labs Ireland, the role will involve live telemetry processing, research, training, evaluation, and deployment of reinforcement-learning controllers across two MODPODs in the Customer Innovation Centre (CIC) data centre. You will validate control policies through replay, hardware-in-the-loop, shadow-mode, and controlled live trials. This is an applied research role spanning physical-system modelling, software engineering, machine learning, and operational deployment.

You will collaborate with our international project partners: the University of Porto, CNRS, Savery Tech, RWTH Aachen, Swerim, TerraBarrier, and Daikin Applied.

  

## **The Opportunity**

Hewlett Packard Labs is seeking a highly qualified, self-motivated machine-learning and AI researcher to join its growing AI research team in Ireland. The role will accelerate research on digital twins that incorporate machine learning, with a focus on the AIRCAS programme.

You will develop and deploy advanced reinforcement-learning control for a live data-centre environment. The work spans research, software engineering, and experimental validation: from data collection and physical-system modelling through forecasting, control-policy training, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow operation, and bounded live trials.

* Build the CIC data and workload pipeline, including controlled workload generation, telemetry ingestion, time-series data management, data-quality checks, and baseline datasets.

* Develop probabilistic forecasts for IT load, cooling demand, and relevant water and heat signals using CIC operational data.
* Research, implement, train, and evaluate objective-shifting multi-objective reinforcement-learning policies that balance flexibility, cost, carbon, water use, and durability within hard safety limits.
* Implement a price-response interface that produces feasible, auditable flexibility commitments with uncertainty information.
* Validate the control stack through replay, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow mode, and controlled actuation windows on the CIC MODPODs.
* Produce reproducible evidence for flexibility, reliability, sustainability, and durability performance, including measurement-and-verification workflows and KPI analysis.
* Collaborate with HPE Labs researchers and the AIRCAS partners to integrate laboratory cooling results, sustainability signals, and physical operating guardrails into the control system.

Hewlett Packard Labs is HPE's central research organisation. Its purpose is to deliver breakthrough technologies that create a competitive advantage for HPE, investing in fundamental areas of strategic interest and preparing resulting technologies for adoption.

At Humanoid, we are working from a simple hypothesis that AI is rapidly transforming engineering. The bottlenecks are shifting from writing code to how efficiently AI-authored changes can be verified.

We’re looking for an Engineering Lead to own developer productivity in the age of AI and agents. You’ll build the platform that lets our engineers move faster with coding agents while protecting our code, infrastructure, and robots. You’ll give developers and agents the environments, context, and tools to work effectively, and build verification and security into the path from task to healthy deployment. This means rethinking how engineering work gets done, not just adding agents to existing processes, and establishing the access controls, isolation, and monitoring needed to guard against mistakes, misuse, and new security threats.

This is a hands-on leadership role and the keystone hire for a new developer productivity team. You’ll build the critical systems yourself, recruit and lead engineers, and work across Developer Tools, Security, Safety, Simulation, and robot software. Success means increasing engineering output while reducing cost and human review per accepted change, without increasing defects or safety risk.  
  
**What you'll do:**

* Own the path from an agent task to a healthy deployed change, including acceptance criteria, execution, verification, merge, rollout, monitoring, and rollback.
* Build secure, reproducible agent runtimes with task-scoped identity, short-lived credentials, bounded access, cost controls, and re-playable execution records. Proactively detect unauthorized agent activity across our compute clusters, whether internal or external.

## Company Description

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

## Job Description

The GTM Lead - AI Optimization Product is responsible for driving the global go-to-market (GTM) success of IFS's Optimisation portfolio — Planning & Scheduling Optimization (PSO), Manufacturing Scheduling & Optimization (MSO), and the What-If Scenario Explorer (WISE). Acting as the commercial and proposition owner across these offerings, this role works across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to define the GTM strategy, build the proposition, and accelerate pipeline growth and strategic deal execution.

This is a cross-portfolio role rather than a single-product sales role. AI is a collection of capabilities spanning machine learning through to agentic and frontier large language models, and the Optimisation portfolio completes that stack: PSO, MSO, and WISE apply machine learning to autonomous scheduling, planning, and predictive decisioning, increasingly integrated with agentic and frontier AI approaches to extend what customers can do with them. The AI Optimisation GTM Lead is responsible for defining the strategy and narrative that connects PSO, MSO, and WISE within this broader AI stack: how optimisation, scheduling, and predictive modeling combine to help customers make better decisions, faster, with less manual effort. The role owns the offering GTM plan, faces off directly to the product teams, and carries a number for the portfolio.

Success in this role is measured through pipeline generation, proposition and GTM adoption, strategic deal influence, and overall commercial performance of the Optimisation portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Proposition

* Own and execute the global GTM strategy for the Optimisation portfolio (PSO, MSO, WISE), ensuring alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partners.

* Act as the commercial owner and cross-portfolio AI strategist for Optimisation, defining the common theme and narrative that connects PSO, MSO, and WISE as a single proposition rather than three disconnected products.

* Face off directly to the product teams to shape roadmap priorities, packaging, and monetisation based on market and customer feedback.

* Develop and continuously refine repeatable GTM motions that accelerate market penetration and revenue growth across the portfolio.

Sales Plays & Commercial Strategy

* Define, launch, and optimise high-impact sales plays for PSO, MSO, and WISE — individually and as a combined optimisation proposition.

* Build commercial motions that enable both standalone Optimisation opportunities and attach opportunities alongside IFS Cloud and adjacent AI offerings such as Nexus Black and IFS.ai.

* Identify market opportunities, competitive positioning, and customer use cases across field service, high-tech and discrete manufacturing, and scenario planning.

* Continuously evaluate sales performance and refine GTM approaches based on market feedback and commercial outcomes.

Strategic Deal Leadership

* Personally support and influence the company's largest global Optimisation opportunities, including the top strategic standalone deals.

* Partner with regional sales leaders throughout complex sales cycles to improve deal quality, competitive positioning, and win rates.

* Facilitate executive engagement and cross-functional collaboration for strategic pursuits.

* Capture and share best practices from major opportunities to improve repeatability across the organisation.

Pipeline Growth & Revenue Enablement

* Drive a sustainable pipeline strategy targeting a minimum four-times pipeline coverage against revenue objectives for the Optimisation portfolio.

* Partner with Marketing to develop and execute demand generation campaigns that create qualified pipeline for PSO, MSO, and WISE.

* Monitor pipeline health, campaign effectiveness, and conversion metrics, recommending corrective actions where required.

* Identify opportunities to improve pipeline quality, sales velocity, and forecast accuracy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Product Management across PSO, MSO, and WISE to ensure market feedback influences product direction and roadmap priorities.

* Partner with Marketing to create compelling messaging, customer stories, thought leadership, and campaign content that articulate the Optimisation portfolio's AI narrative.

* Collaborate with Sales Enablement to develop training, playbooks, and sales resources that increase field effectiveness.

* Support Partner teams with GTM strategies that expand market reach through the ecosystem.

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

* Define and monitor key commercial performance metrics across pipeline generation, win rates, deal progression, and GTM effectiveness for the portfolio.

* Provide regular updates and recommendations to senior leadership, including the AI Business Unit, on market performance, strategic opportunities, and execution priorities.

* Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve execution, and increase commercial impact.

**Success Measures**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

* Delivery of global GTM campaigns that generate measurable pipeline growth across PSO, MSO, and WISE.

* Achievement of at least a 4x pipeline multiple against commercial targets.

* Growth in standalone Optimisation revenue alongside increased IFS Cloud attachment rates.

* Establishment of a single, coherent Optimisation portfolio narrative and proposition across PSO, MSO, and WISE.

* Successful support and influence of the company's top strategic Optimisation opportunities globally.

* Increased adoption of Optimisation sales plays across global sales teams.

* Improved win rates, pipeline conversion, and commercial predictability.

* Strong cross-functional alignment that accelerates market execution and customer adoption.

## Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise software, SaaS, or technology organisations within Go-to-Market, Product Marketing, Sales Strategy, Business Development, or related commercial roles.

* Demonstrated success developing and executing global GTM strategies for enterprise software products, ideally spanning multiple products or a portfolio.

* Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and influencing strategic customer opportunities.

* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales motions, including pipeline generation, solution selling, and partner ecosystems.

* Experience working across multiple business functions including Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership.

* Domain knowledge of optimisation, scheduling, or planning technologies is highly advantageous — for example, field service planning and scheduling optimisation (PSO), manufacturing scheduling and digital-twin-based planning (MSO), or scenario modeling and predictive analytics (WISE / what-if analysis).

* Familiarity with the full spectrum of AI capabilities, from machine learning through to agentic and frontier AI approaches, and the ability to translate technical AI capability into a clear commercial proposition.

* Knowledge of Field Service Management, Enterprise Asset Management, Manufacturing, ERP, Industrial AI, or enterprise business applications is advantageous.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Technology, or a related discipline. MBA is beneficial.

Skills & Competencies

* Commercial mindset with strong business and revenue acumen.

* Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution.

* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills.

* Ability to influence senior executives and global sales organisations without direct authority.

* Ability to translate complex AI, optimisation, and scheduling concepts into clear, customer-facing propositions.

* Strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills.

* Data-driven decision making with the ability to translate insights into commercial action.

* Strong project and program management capabilities.

* Ability to thrive in fast-paced, global, and matrixed environments.

* Passion for building repeatable GTM motions that drive measurable business outcomes.

## Additional Information

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

Our mission at Calibr is to help companies build in-house AI capability. Our approach is simple: help businesses identify where AI can create the most value, prove it in a focused part of the business and build the capability to navigate AI adoption long term.

* Explain architecture decisions, their trade-offs and risks in terms non-technical stakeholders can act on.

* Distinguishing a model safety issue from an application security issue.

job_title: Course Writer and Editor: UX, UI, and AI
job_description:
## About this role

You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed that **you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it**. You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand.

Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world.

A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include **[REDACTED] and [REDACTED]**, as well as Design Leads at **[REDACTED], [REDACTED], [REDACTED], and [REDACTED]**.

You’ll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to **take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow**. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

## Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

[REDACTED] is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like [REDACTED], [REDACTED], and [REDACTED], who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us **take online education to new heights** and **make a meaningful impact on humankind**.

At [REDACTED], we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

## We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

* **Our Course Writers and Editors:** lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective. **This is the role described here.**
* **Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:** lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.
* **Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:** lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

We’re a flexible team, and you’ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

**You, the Course Writer and Editor**, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. Our **Education Designers** hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with our **Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors**, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

## Your Role at [REDACTED]

* **Be a core part of our Editorial Team.** You'll collaborate with [REDACTED] editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to **create educational content for people worldwide**. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills in **timeless, human-centered design and AI**.
* **Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.** The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.
* **You don't need a design background.** Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.
* **Write for a diverse, global audience.** Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.
* **Be the voice of [REDACTED].** Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours. **Represent a global movement dedicated to design education**, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.
* **Set and raise the standard for our assessments**, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.
* **Balance the big picture with the smaller details.** Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.
* **Turn expert material into lessons.** Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.
* Our courses **combine written and video lessons.** You'll work closely with the video team, giving **constructive feedback** on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

ABOUT CIRCUITHUB

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Product Engineer at CircuitHub, you will own entire production software systems end-to-end, from understanding operational problems on the factory floor through designing, building, deploying, and operating the software that solves them. You’ll be responsible for entire systems rather than isolated tickets, owning problems from discovery through deployment and operational impact.

This includes building and maintaining the internal operational stack that seamlessly connects planning, materials, purchasing, personnel, and factory processes, transforming complex manufacturing workflows into highly reliable, usable software. You’ll partner closely with factory operators, engineers, and company leadership to ensure CircuitHub’s factories scale smoothly as demand and Grid capabilities grow.

Example Projects

* Develop production planning tools and inventory/materials-flow systems

* Improve factory operator workflows

* Integrate new automation equipment

* Apply AI and LLMs to automate operational decision making, from purchasing and production planning to machine diagnostics and debugging.

* Build the software systems that coordinate thousands of manufacturing decisions across people, robots, inventory, and suppliers in real time.

Must-haves

* Strong PostgreSQL experience: complex queries, performance tuning, and schema design

* Solid data modeling and systems-design judgment

* Hands-on systems integration: stitching together APIs, tools, and workflows that hold up in production

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to ship production systems quickly and reliably.

* Willingness and ability to travel regularly to CircuitHub factories (US and UK) and spend time on the factory floor partnering closely with operators and engineers.

Nice-to-haves

* Familiarity with manufacturing, logistics, ERP/MRP, or supply-chain systems

* Experience building internal tools or operational software

* Experience keeping mission-critical operational systems fast and reliable

* Comfortable collaborating closely with internal teams on regular basis

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You’ll work directly with the Head of Internal Software and company leadership to identify bottlenecks and turn them into software systems that improve factory throughput. You'll join the internal software team and work alongside engineers, factory operators, and leadership.

In your first 6–12 months, success looks like owning a meaningful slice of the production operations stack outright and measurably improving the reliability and throughput of the operations it supports.

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
Location
This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in UK & Europe region.
About the team
Production Scheduling is the process of arranging, controlling, and optimizing work and workloads in a manufacturing environment. Kinaxis Enterprise Scheduling unifies production planning and detailed scheduling on a single, concurrent platform—allowing planners and schedulers to immediately understand the impact of demand and supply changes, from long-term plans down to the shop floor schedule.The Enterprise Scheduling team builds and scales an enterprise-grade scheduling application with the flexibility of a site-level scheduler. We focus on developing fast, scalable algorithms, applying heuristic and optimization techniques where they deliver the most value, and ensuring our solutions are configurable, extensible, and production-ready. Our challenges are complex, our data is large, and our customers rely on us to deliver correctness, performance, and explainability at scale.
Vacancy Status
This is an existing job vacancy 
What you will do
As a Senior Algorithm Developer, you will contribute across the full lifecycle of algorithm backed product development, working at the intersection of real-world scheduling problems and enterprise software delivery.You will:
Design, implement, and test production scheduling models, constraints, heuristics, and meta heuristics
Translate real-world manufacturing and scheduling constraints into robust computational and mathematical models
Investigate and apply advanced scheduling techniques, including targeted use of AI/ML where appropriate

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. You will need to balance competing priorities across two products, establish trusted data methodologies, engage customers and bring both products to market through a pragmatic, build-and-iterate approach.

### Key Responsibilities

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Cruise Liners and Port Operations, prioritising customer needs and commercial opportunities while making trade-offs between the two products explicit.
