* Establish trusted data and benchmarking methodologies for both products, developing an independent view of cruise itineraries, fuel and emissions, alongside consistent port call-cycle measurement and performance benchmarking.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Sales, Product Marketing and other product teams to align delivery, reuse shared data and emissions capabilities, and develop early data and distribution partnerships.
* Define the Cruise Liners product direction, delivering fleet itinerary intelligence based on live, observed vessel movements that reflects actual sailed journeys rather than published schedules.
* Build the Port Operations product, providing port authorities with a reliable, live view of vessel activity using Kpler’s AIS receiver network and mapped port and berth data.
* Develop product positioning and competitive strategy, identifying opportunities to differentiate Kpler’s independent, first-party observed data from existing cruise analytics and port operations offerings.
* Drive go-to-market execution for both products, working with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input and launch planning, and establishing repeatable customer discovery and design partnerships.

### Skills & Experience

* 6–10 years of senior product or commercial experience in maritime data, cruise or travel, ports, or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS business, with a proven track record of delivering products that customers adopt.
* Working fluency in at least one of cruise or port operations, with the ability to develop expertise quickly in the other.
* Direct experience in the cruise or ports industry, with an established network among operators, port authorities and terminals.
* Experience translating customer needs into product strategy and working closely with product and engineering teams to deliver solutions.
* Experience managing multiple products or workstreams simultaneously, balancing competing priorities and maintaining delivery momentum.
* Strong product discovery and roadmap prioritisation skills, with the ability to engage customers and translate market insights into actionable product requirements.
* Experience working with data and engineering teams to deliver data-driven products.
* Understanding of go-to-market planning, including product positioning, packaging and pricing input.

## Description

Role purpose

Legatics handles some of the world's most complex and confidential legal transactions, so security is core to our product and to client trust. As our Security Engineer, you will make our platform, cloud estate and internal systems secure by design, working hand in hand with our engineering team.

Reporting to the Head of Engineering, this is a permanent, hands-on role where you will work at least two days a week in our London office. Your core focus is application and product security, cloud, identity and endpoint security, and security monitoring and detection. You will also lead incident response and help set our approach to AI security as our teams build with agentic tools.

For around the first 12 months, you will also own our ISO 27001, compliance and client assurance work, supported by AI tooling we have already built for client questionnaires and ISO evidence. This is a broad role with real autonomy, suited to someone who enjoys both building and securing.

About Legatics

Legatics is one of the world's leading LegalTech scale-ups. Our legal transaction management platform enables law firms and their clients to collaborate on and close deals in an interactive online environment, providing clarity, reducing risk and saving time.

Our customers include some of the world's top law firms, such as A&O Shearman, Hogan Lovells, Herbert Smith Freehills and King & Wood Mallesons. Legatics has been used on transactions in more than 60 countries, worth over $1 trillion.

### Key responsibilities

### Application and product security

* Carry out technical risk assessments on new and existing product features, including permissions and access control design.
* Embed security into our software development lifecycle through threat modelling, secure code review and security requirements for new features.
* Perform vulnerability and exploitability analysis, including CVE triage and dependency risk, and prioritise remediation with engineers based on real exposure.
* Operate and consolidate our security scanning and posture tooling, and centralise findings so they are tracked and resolved.
* Review the security risk of proposed integrations and data flows, including third-party tools and automations.
* Run a programme of continuous security testing, including penetration tests, and own remediation of findings.

### Cloud, identity and endpoint security

* Audit and harden our cloud and identity posture, including SSO enforcement, conditional access and third-party app controls.
* Automate joiner and leaver access, and run periodic user access reviews across our SaaS estate.
* Own email security and authentication.
* Own endpoint security across our Windows and Mac fleet, including EDR policy tuning and validation testing.
* Design and maintain federated authentication with clear rollout guides and rollback procedures.

### Security monitoring and detection

* Build, extend and maintain security monitoring across our technical estate, including log aggregation, correlation and alerting.
* Tune detection rules and alerting to improve signal quality and reduce false positives.
* Maintain threat intelligence and security news pipelines to keep the team informed.

### Incident response

* Lead detection, triage, containment and response for security incidents, including supply-chain compromises affecting third-party tools.
* Assess blast radius, advise on practical containment and maintain escalation and breach procedures.
* Write clear incident communications for technical and non-technical audiences, including clients where needed.

### AI security

* Shape our AI security posture, positioning security as an enabler for teams building with AI and agentic tools.
* Implement access controls, secrets scanning and detection for internal AI systems and MCP integrations, mapped to frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications.
* Research AI coding risks, such as slopsquatting and hallucinated packages, and feed findings into engineering practice.

### ISO 27001, compliance and client assurance

For around the first 12 months, you will own:

* Our ISO 27001:2022 certified ISMS, including the risk register, Statement of Applicability, policies and audit evidence, and preparation for surveillance audits.
* Client information security questionnaires and security queries from our commercial team, using the AI tooling we have built to speed these up.
* Client conversations about our security posture and remediation updates, for example on penetration test findings.

After this period, you will continue to contribute technical controls, evidence and expertise to our ISMS and client assurance work.

### IT operations

* Support day-to-day IT and tooling needs as a secondary responsibility, including connector provisioning, access permissions and IAM configuration for internal data tools.

You do not need every item below. If you have strong foundations and are keen to learn the rest, we would like to hear from you.

### Essential

* Hands-on experience in a security engineering, application security or cloud security role.
* Strong knowledge of web application security, including OWASP principles, authentication and authorisation, and secure API design.
* Practical experience of vulnerability management, from triage to working with engineers on remediation.

# Operations Strategy Manager - CX

Full-time

## Why We Exist

Our mission is to transform how technology is bought, used and reused - creating better outcomes for customers, brands and the planet.

## What We've Built

Raylo is the subscription infrastructure that enables leading electronics brands, including PlayStation, HP and Dyson, to move from one-off device sales to recurring subscription programmes that increase conversion, deepen loyalty and capture more lifetime value.

For customers, the experience is simple: subscribe to a device, get support throughout, upgrade when you want, and return it when you’re done. Behind that sits an AI-powered operating system that executes and manages device subscriptions end to end: credit and fraud decisioning, lifecycle operations, and the financing engine that enables brands to run subscription programmes at scale.

Brands can unlock a powerful new growth engine with Raylo across embedded checkout, Raylo.com and the customer app — converting more DTC customers, reaching subscription-first demand, and driving repeat upgrades that compound customer lifetime value.

The impact of our circular model is big. We cut emissions per device by around 50% compared to buy-and-discard. We’re B Corp certified, backed by Macquarie, NatWest and Channel 4 Ventures, and recognised by Tech Nation’s Future Fifty.

## How We Work

AI is changing what small, ambitious teams can build. Companies that embrace it will define the next decade.

Raylo is uniquely placed to benefit. We combine proprietary technology and data with the orchestration of physical assets, operating across credit, fraud, pricing, logistics, refurbishment, resale and customer care. With AI improving every cycle, our moat deepens with scale.

At Raylo, AI is woven into how we work every day. We don’t ration access or hedge our bets. Our people use the best models and tools, and we expect them to do things that weren’t possible a year ago. Processes that used to be good enough are being rebuilt. Teams are replacing spreadsheets with bespoke tooling, and anyone can query our data layer in plain English and get a real answer in seconds.

We give every team their own hackathon: a chance to step back, start with a blank sheet, and ask: if we were starting today, how would we do this?

The more we automate, the more human judgement matters. AI gives people back time, and we expect them to spend it on the things no model can replicate: conversations, trust, craft and team judgement.

We hire to a high bar. You’ll work with people who push you, raise your game and expect you to do the same. We want every person at Raylo to do the best work of their lives, and enjoy doing it.

## 💡 Be deeply curious

– We thrive on innovation through diverse approaches, views, and people.

## 👟 Walk in your customer’s shoes

– To build the best products and make the best decisions for the long term, we must figure out what our customers need, not just what they want.

## 🎯 Focus and execute

– We have a big vision, but we believe in nailing the most important problems first.

## 💥 Be gritty

– Only gritty teams succeed. Our individual ownership, passion, and perseverance mean we’re a team through thick and thin.

## Your Team

* Operations Strategy supports Raylo's ability to scale, improve efficiency and become more effective. We sit within Operations and own the Customer Experience, Supply Chain, and Revenue and Billing pillars. Our remit is to own operational projects, launch new initiatives and optimise processes that drive positive outcomes for Raylo's growth ambitions.
* AI is at the centre of how we work. We do not ration access, we use the best models, and we expect everyone on the team to push the tools harder than we currently do.
* This role owns the Customer Experience pillar end to end, and works closely with the Billing, Insurance, and Product and Engineering teams. As Raylo moves from a UK business to a global one, this role is accountable for making sure customer experience holds to the same standard everywhere, not just in the market we know best.

## What You’ll Do

* **Own what Wow CX means at Raylo.** Define the standard for a great interaction, hold every team (human or AI) to it, and be the escalation point and voice of the customer in cross-functional decisions, including product and engineering prioritisation.
* **Run the NPS programme end to end.** Own the survey infrastructure, run weekly and monthly analysis of headline scores, journey trends and verbatim themes, and turn that insight into decisions rather than a scorecard.
* **Anticipate pain points early.** Monitor feedback across Trustpilot, Intercom and NPS verbatims, quantify the cost of what you find, and build the business case for fixing it.
* **Own operational mass comms governance.** Audit, edit and govern the CX and service comms Raylo sends at scale, across customer.io and Fin: delivery updates, lifecycle messages, NPS surveys and Fin-driven support comms.
* **Triage and project manage major CX projects and issues.** Take ownership of live projects and issues end to end: root cause, fix, communication and close-out, coordinating internal teams as needed.
* **Set the global CX standard.** As Raylo launches into new markets, starting with the US, define what consistent CX means across markets and across our full device range, and build the standards and playbooks that stop quality slipping as we scale.
* **Test CX systematically, not just react to it.** Design and run structured testing across key customer journeys, including AI-handled paths, so we catch gaps before customers do.
* **Look outside Raylo for the bar to beat.** Study best-in-class CX from other industries (retail, travel, banking, hospitality) and bring back what's genuinely applicable, not just what other subscription businesses are doing.

## You’ll Succeed With

* **3-7 years' experience** in a customer experience, operations or strategy role, ideally with time in a scaleup, consulting or FMCG environment where you had direct exposure to the customer insights and worked at pace.
* **Degree level education** , ideally in a STEM or analytical discipline.
* **A genuine, sustained curiosity about the customer.** You notice pain points before they're reported, and you can't walk past a broken journey without wanting to fix it.
* **Comfortable building the case for change.** You can take a messy problem, quantify it, and write a business case that gets funded and shipped, not just noticed.
* **Some hands-on experience with a marketing automation or comms platform.** You've built, audited or governed comms sent at scale on a marketing automation platform, Customer.io experience is a strong plus, since that's our stack, but not required.
* **Strong analytical skills.** Confident in Excel or Google Sheets and tools like Looker, with the ability to pull data, find the root cause and write it up clearly. SQL experience is a plus; if you're not there yet, you'll get there quickly.
* **Deep curiosity and fluency with frontier AI tools.** You use Claude or ChatGPT daily, and have a view on how AI changes customer experience and support over the next few years.
* **Project management experience.** You can run several cross-functional issues at once, keep momentum, and know when to escalate versus when to push through.
* **Strong communication skills.** You're comfortable flagging issues early, explaining things clearly, and adapting your style depending on who you're talking to, from frontline teams to leadership.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** This is a build-as-you-go role in a business moving from UK to global. You'll often be deciding what standard to set, not just following one.

## Opportunities & Benefits

🚀 Fast-track your career – 40% of our employees progress every review cycle (bi-annually)

📱 Exclusive Raylo device subscription for employees

🏥 Private Medical Insurance

📈 Stock options for all employees

📚 L&D budget to support the skills you value

🏢 4 days in the Raylo Belfast Office, with 1 day working from home per week.

🌴 33 days off, your way – 25 days + 8 bank holidays with full flexibility to use on the days that mean the most to you

👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption or shared parental leave, if you've been with us for 12 months.

🧸 Workplace nursery scheme for major cost savings

## Hiring Process

We move quickly and we'll aim to give you the best candidate experience possible. It starts with a 15-minute call — no prep needed. If there's a fit, we move fast, every stage has a purpose, and we'll tell you what we're looking for at each one.

**If there's anything we can do to support you through the process, whether that's adjustments or anything else, please let us know.**

## Diversity & Inclusion at Raylo

At Raylo, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, believing they make us stronger.

### **Business Context**

You will work within the **Structured Products Middle Office (SPMO)** team, sitting directly within the **Product Control department inside Global Markets Operations** at a Tier-1 Investment Bank.

Operating as an independent second-level control function, Product Control is responsible for monitoring transaction representation, Front-to-Back workflows from Front Office to Post-Trade systems, and enforcing valuation and operational risk controls. The team supports complex, high-value desks including **Structured Credit, Rates, Fixed Income, Global Macro IR, and FXLM products**.

We are hiring for **two distinct operational profiles** to manage deal stock throughout its lifetime and ensure high operational integrity across live flows.

### **Role Overview**

The **Structured Products Middle Office Analyst** ensures that complex transactions across Fixed Income, Credit, Rates, and FX derivatives are booked accurately, conformed to legal documentation terms, and properly controlled throughout their lifecycle.

Depending on your core specialization, you will either drive **reconciliations and break resolution** (Profile 1) or manage **trade lifecycle execution and operational investigations** (Profile 2).

## **Role 1: Reconciliations & Break Investigation Specialist**

*Focus: Control-driven operational accounting, financial break resolution, ledger flows, and root-cause analysis.*

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform daily hands-on investigation and resolution of **Nostro breaks, Cash breaks, and General Ledger / Accounting breaks** across complex derivative perimeters.
* Reconcile suspense accounts, balance sheet items, and P&L ledgers to ensure Front-to-Back data integrity.

# FP&A Analyst (Revenue & COGS) – Entry Level role

Req #2138

## Job Description

Posted Sunday, October 18, 2026 at 10:00 PM

**Who we are**

At MediaKind, we’ve reshaped the future of streaming video.

As the world’s largest independent video technology company, and the leader in sports streaming, we power the most ambitious and demanding video experiences on the planet.

Our cloud-native, software-defined solutions help the world’s leading streamers and broadcasters build, deploy and scale premium video experiences. Its MK.IO platform helps customers launch and scale streaming services. Finance supports a business that mixes software subscriptions, usage-based cloud services, licenses, and professional and managed services, so revenue and delivery cost do not follow one simple pattern.

If you're excited by solving complex challenges, working alongside talented colleagues around the world, and helping shape the future of video, we'd love to build what's next together.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an FP&A Analyst to own revenue and cost of goods sold (COGS) forecasting, reporting and analysis. You will be the person the business turns to for an accurate answer on what we will bill, what it will cost to deliver, and what margin that leaves. The role sits in Finance and works daily with Sales, Operations and Customer Delivery.

This is a hands-on analyst role. You will help build and maintain the models, reconcile them to the general ledger, and explain the movements to non-finance leaders in plain language.

**Key responsibilities**

**Revenue**

* Build and maintain the monthly, quarterly and annual revenue forecast by division, customer and revenue type (subscription, usage, license, services, support).
* Combine closed actuals, invoiced and to-be-invoiced orders, and the sales pipeline into one view of revenue by period.
* Track backlog and open orders, flag slippage, and quantify the revenue impact of deal timing changes.
* Analyze revenue versus budget, forecast and prior year, and write the variance commentary: volume, price, mix and timing.
* Support revenue recognition review with Accounting, including checks on contract terms and billing schedules.

**COGS and gross margin**

* Forecast and report COGS split between direct costs (hosting, third-party licenses, royalties, delivery and support labour) and indirect costs allocated to delivery.
* Calculate gross margin by division, customer and project, and highlight where margin is falling and why.
* Maintain the mapping of general ledger accounts to revenue and COGS categories so reporting stays consistent.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering on cloud and vendor cost drivers, and model the margin effect of pricing, contract and architecture changes.
* Build customer and deal-level margin analysis to support pricing and renewal decisions.

**Reporting and close**

* Run the monthly gross margin close: refresh the GL data, reconcile to the ledger, and confirm summaries tie out.
* Produce the revenue and COGS pages of the monthly management pack and board reporting.
* Support budget and reforecast cycles with accurate, well-documented assumptions.

**Partnering and improvement**

* Meet regularly with Sales, Customer Delivery and Operations to challenge assumptions and explain results.
* Answer ad hoc questions from the CFO and leadership team with clear, fast analysis.
* Document models and processes and automate repeat reporting so the team spends time on analysis, not on rebuilding spreadsheets.

## **Requirements**

* 3 or more years in FP&A, financial analysis or a similar finance role.
* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field. Relevant experience will also be considered.
* Direct experience forecasting revenue and analyzing gross margin or COGS.
* Advanced Excel: lookups, pivot tables, multi-tab models, and the discipline to make every total tie out. Comfortable with large general ledger exports.
* Working knowledge of an ERP such as Oracle, and of a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Clear written and spoken communication. You can explain a variance to a sales director without jargon.
* Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work before anyone else sees it.

## **Nice to have**

* SQL, Power BI, Tableau or similar for reporting and dashboards.
* Experience with planning tools such as Adaptive, Anaplan or Planful.
* Python or other scripting to automate recurring reporting.
* Experience with cloud cost reporting (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) and usage-based billing.
* Exposure to multi-currency reporting and intercompany allocations.
* Experience with Ai Tools

## **What success looks like**

| Timeframe | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| First 30 days | Learn the GL, the revenue and COGS mappings, and the month-end close. Shadow one full close and tie out the gross margin summary. |
| First 60 days | Run the revenue and COGS reporting for a month with light review. Take over the variance commentary for at least one division. |
| First 90 days | Own the revenue and COGS forecast end to end. Deliver one analysis that changes a pricing, contract or cost decision. Propose and start one automation of a manual report. |

**Location**

Southampton, Hybrid

* Competitive salary and bonus structure
* Comprehensive benefits package
* MediaKindness Wellbeing Program
* Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
* Collaborative and dynamic work environment
* Flexible work arrangements, including hybrid work options

Here at MediaKind, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive workplace where we appreciate the unique skills, capabilities and perspectives that our people bring. We believe that diverse teams are better for our employees, customers and our business. Everyone’s identity, background and life experiences add to the MediaKind story, and we welcome all.

Medtronic Neuromodulation has pioneered life-changing therapies for 50 years, helping patients with movement disorders and chronic pain. From spinal cord stimulation and deep brain stimulation to implantable drug delivery systems, we continue to advance technologies that restore patient freedom. Our vision is to become the undisputed world leader in Neuromodulation, improving patient lives through innovative solutions.  
  
The Senior Materials R&D Engineer will provide materials expertise within the Galway Interventional R&D team, with technical ownership of the bone cement materials portfolio.  
  
Collaborating with global colleagues, suppliers and partners to develop and optimise medical device materials and processes. The role spans early investigation through verification, validation and commercialisation, alongside support for existing products. You will guide materials selection, characterisation and testing, resolve complex technical challenges and mentor colleagues to deliver safe, reliable products that support our vision. Expertise in bone cement formulation, processing and performance evaluation would be an advantage.  
Come for a job, stay for a career!

Within Medtronic’s Neuromodulation R&D organisation, you will work with teams developing and testing products for the Pain Interventions business. The team develops innovative, minimally invasive therapies for musculoskeletal conditions, including vertebral compression fractures, nerve pain, and metastatic and benign bone tumours. The role may be based in Galway, Ireland or Minneapolis, Minnesota, and will work with colleagues across sites.

  

As a Senior Materials R&D Engineer, you will provide materials science and engineering expertise to new product development and released product reliability teams. Your work will include materials selection and problem-solving, with a focus on areas such as balloon catheter design, bone cement optimisation and polymer component design.

  

You will contribute technical leadership in materials processing, characterisation and analysis, and help teams understand how material properties and processing affect product performance. You will also support material stability, biocompatibility and biostability assessments; identify and help mitigate product-related risks; and communicate technical issues, resource gaps and recommendations to project and functional leaders.

  

Working with cross-functional teams, you will help shape product strategies, identify technologies and initiatives needed to develop innovative, reliable and cost-effective therapies, and develop and execute plans to address those needs.

You will also contribute to intellectual property generation:

  

* Contribute to the development of products used in medical procedures, aligned with business needs and patient requirements.

* Address complex materials challenges across early-phase product development projects, using sound engineering judgement and materials science expertise.

* Apply materials science principles to develop and evaluate polymer and composite material solutions, including associated manufacturing, fabrication and assembly processes.

* Provide materials expertise to new product development teams and support sustaining engineering activities for commercial products.

* Take technical ownership of the bone cement materials portfolio, supporting development, material characterisation, performance evaluation and sustaining activities. Previous bone cement expertise would be an advantage

* Lead the development of product and process requirements, with particular focus on material specifications.

* Establish effective, reliable and cost-conscious material processing methods for manufacturing.

* Provide technical support for clinical programmes, field-related activities and complaint investigations.

* Lead design and technical reviews with cross-functional partners, suppliers and other stakeholders.

* Develop strategies and evaluation plans to address gaps in materials, design and processes, balancing timelines, cost, technical requirements, patient safety and product reliability.

* Participate in sourcing, testing and approval of materials.

* Set technical expectations for supplier and vendor deliverables, review their work and provide direction as needed.

* Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.

### 

## Key Skills & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Chemistry, Polymer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, with at least seven years of relevant experience; or a master’s degree with at least 4 years of relevant experience; or a PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience

* Developing, analysing or specifying materials and related processing or fabrication methods

* Material characterisation, laboratory testing, test method development and interpretation of technical data.

* Knowledge of material properties, design requirements, processing controls and quality specifications

* Medical device development or another regulated industry is preferred.

* Polymers, biomaterials, bone cement or other materials used in implantable or interventional devices is an advantage.

* Familiarity with design controls, risk management, material equivalency, failure analysis or supplier process reviews is beneficial.

* Knowledge of design of experiments, statistical methods, Six Sigma or design for manufacture.

* Ability to work independently on complex technical problems, manage project deliverables and influence decisions through clear technical communication.

* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across functions, sites and organisational boundaries.

## Intern, Research - Context and Knowledge Systems for AI

Apply

**Job Requisition ID #**

26WD101097

Autodesk Research – Intelligent Construction

Summer 2027 | 12 weeks

  

**Position Overview**

Modern AI systems increasingly depend on their ability to access and use the right context at

the right time. An important research challenge is how large, evolving bodies of information

should be represented to support reliable inference.

Autodesk Research provides a distinctive setting for this work. Construction projects are rich,

complex information environments whose state changes continuously over time, making

them a compelling domain for studying context and knowledge systems for AI.

As a Research Intern, you will own a focused research problem in this area. You will

investigate new approaches to building and retrieving structured context, develop

experimental prototypes, and evaluate how effectively they support downstream AI

reasoning.

You will work closely with Autodesk researchers and engineers and have substantial freedom

to bring ideas from your own research. Strong contributions may form the basis of an

academic publication and future Autodesk research.

  

**Responsibilities**

• Conduct original research in context and knowledge systems for AI. Investigate

methods for representing and retrieving information to support reliable contextual

inference

• Develop new approaches to context construction. Explore how relevant knowledge

can be identified and assembled dynamically from large and evolving information

environments

• Build research prototypes. Implement experimental systems using graph-based,

semantic or hybrid approaches and apply them to realistic project information

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments. Develop suitable research questions,

baselines and evaluation methods to understand the strengths and limitations of

proposed approaches

• Collaborate with Autodesk researchers and engineers. Work across AI research,

software engineering and domain expertise to refine ideas and translate them into

experimental systems

• Communicate research findings. Present results within Autodesk Research and

contribute, where appropriate, to research papers, technical reports and

demonstrations

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

• Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Data Science, Information Science or a closely related field, with at least one

academic term remaining after the internship

• Research experience in an area related to knowledge representation, information

retrieval, data management or contextual information systems for AI

• Strong programming skills and experience developing experimental research

software

• Understanding of contemporary AI systems and how retrieval and contextual

information support modern reasoning or agentic workflows

• Experience formulating research questions and designing empirical evaluations.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Research experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:

• Knowledge graphs or graph-based information systems

• Advanced information retrieval and hybrid retrieval methods

• Retrieval-augmented generation, including GraphRAG or related approaches

• Context engineering or memory architectures for AI systems

• Semantic and structured knowledge representation

• Temporal, provenance-aware or evolving data systems

• Heterogeneous data integration at scale

• Graph machine learning applied to representation or retrieval

A strong research publication record in a relevant area is desirable

  

Prior experience with architecture, engineering or construction is not required. We are

particularly interested in candidates with deep technical expertise who are motivated by the

opportunity to test their research against a complex real-world information environment.

  

**About the Team**

Autodesk Research explores technologies that may shape how the world is designed and

made. We work across fundamental and applied research, developing new ideas and testing

them against problems grounded in professional practice.

The Intelligent Construction team investigates how emerging forms of AI can support a more

connected and adaptive construction industry. An important part of that challenge is

understanding how fragmented project information can become a coherent and evolving

source of knowledge for intelligent systems.

You will join a multidisciplinary research environment with expertise spanning AI, data

systems, software engineering and construction. You will work closely with experienced

researchers while having substantial ownership of your own research problem.

Expected Research Outcome

This is a focused **12-week research internship**. The research question will be developed with

the successful candidate to make use of their existing expertise while addressing a problem

relevant to the team's research direction.

By the end of the internship, we expect the intern to have developed and evaluated an original

approach to a clearly defined research problem. This should include a working research

prototype, rigorous experimental evidence and a clear account of the findings and limitations.

The work will be shared within Autodesk Research. Where the research contribution warrants

it, we would expect to develop the work toward publication at an appropriate academic

venue.

# Senior Account Executive UKI

#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

#### **About the role**

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As a Senior Sales Manager at Mews, you will own a territory—and own it at scale. You have 3+ years of proven quota attainment, and you've demonstrated ambition to grow and take on increasingly complex challenges. You will close larger deals, build scalable playbooks, and serve as an ambassador for sales excellence across the team.

Mews powers 15,000+ properties across 85 countries. In 2025, we processed nearly $20 billion in transactions. In 2026, we raised $300 million in Series D funding at a $2.5 billion valuation. We are approaching IPO. The market is global, the product is unmatched, and the territories are genuinely winnable at scale. The question is whether you are the person to own a territory and lift the entire team's standard.

## What you would do

* Full ownership of a territory with quota targets, closing deals (€5,000+)
* Strategic territory growth planning: building 2-3 year plans, not just quarterly targets
* Working with Multi-stakeholder deals
* A pipeline built from outbound prospecting, with strategic account planning and targeted expansion
* Mentoring and coaching of Sales Managers—not just your own discipline, but their development
* Thought partnership with commercial leadership on scaling motions, team development, and market strategy
* Representation of the sales team across cross-functional initiatives
* Use AI to redesign how your territory and team work, not just how you personally work. Build an AI-powered territory analysis framework your team follows. Create deal-coaching workflows that scale your mentoring. Actively question what AI gives you and know when to abandon an output.

**AI Fluency Level 3:** You've redesigned how your territory and team work using AI, not just how you personally work. You've built approaches other Sales Managers follow—whether it's an AI-powered territory analysis framework, a prospecting workflow that uses AI to prioritize accounts, or a deal-coaching process that scales your mentoring. You actively question what AI gives you, push back when it's wrong, and know when to abandon an output entirely. At IC3, you're thinking about how to multiply yourself through AI and through your team, not just how it speeds up your own work.

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates* *on Confluence.*

---

## What you would bring

* You have 3–5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, with 3+ years of full-cycle closing
* You have achieved 100%+ of quota in at least 2 consecutive years, proving sustained performance at scale
* You have diagnosed and fixed market-level problems—not just closed deals, but rebuilt territories or built new motions from scratch
* You know your numbers—ARR targets, attainment rates, deal progression, pipeline metrics.
* You can map your growth across roles: where you started, where you peaked, and why you moved on. You're ambitious about your own growth and you seek out bigger challenges and higher complexity. You move strategically to environments where there's genuine room to expand and where you can keep leveling up
* You build scalable playbooks and mentor others—Sales Managers come to you for advice
* You have a 2-3 year territory vision and can break it into actionable strategy
* Track record of territory turnarounds or market expansion from zero
* You understand what drives you. You tie compensation to personal earnings ambitions and growth opportunities
* AI Fluency Level 3 or equivalent: you've redesigned how work gets done using AI, built approaches others follow, and actively question AI output

#### **Pay Transparency at Mews**

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

#### **What’s in it for you?**

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

#### **Global benefits**

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

* Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
* Participation in our company share program
* Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
* An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development

#### **Local benefits**

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

#### **Life at Mews**

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

* High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
* Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
* We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
* AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

# **ABOUT MODAXO**

Modaxo is a global collective of technology companies focused on People Transportation. Our businesses deliver software and solutions that connect people with the places they need to go. We combine the community and accountability of local businesses with the reach, investment and shared learning of a global organisation.

We operate through a decentralised, multi-brand model. Our businesses retain local ownership and autonomy, while benefiting from relevant knowledge, proven practices and connections across the wider organisation. As Modaxo grows organically and through acquisition, our ability to capture, govern and reuse knowledge becomes increasingly important.

  

# **About the role**

This is a new, high-visibility role with enterprise scope. It is designed to turn expertise spread across Modaxo businesses, functions and leaders into a trusted, accessible and reusable body of knowledge and learning content. This is a strategic knowledge and capability role, accountable for translating priority knowledge into practical application. You will set the knowledge and content strategy, establish the governance model, build a prioritised roadmap and source and curate content with subject matter experts. You will be accountable for the quality and coherence of the global layer, while business units remain free to create local content within agreed standards.

The role will succeed through judgement, influence and value creation. It must balance enterprise priorities with the realities of independently run businesses and make deliberate choices about what should be captured, standardised, scaled, signposted or managed within the businesses.

  

The role is remote and can be based in Eastern Canada or UK/Europe.

  

# **You will deliver**

## 1. Enterprise Knowledge Strategy and Roadmap

* **Set the strategy.** Define the enterprise knowledge and content strategy, aligned to Modaxo priorities and translated into a practical multi-year roadmap.
* **Prioritise for impact.** Build a transparent intake and prioritisation approach with leaders and stakeholders, focusing effort on the knowledge that will create the greatest business value.
* **Own the global layer.** Clarify which knowledge should be owned globally, which should remain local, and where common standards or signposting are sufficient.
* **Connect the portfolio.** Create a coherent view across leadership content, functional playbooks, case studies, templates, AI capability content, acquisition learning and other reusable assets (understanding messaging and different channels and formats).

## 2. Networks, Stakeholder Engagement and Knowledge Sourcing

* **Build a strong network.** Create and support a network of business-unit contributors, content owners and subject matter experts who help surface needs and validate knowledge.
* **Enable communities of practice.** Partner with functional and business leaders to connect practitioners around shared challenges, proven approaches and emerging practice.
* **Make expertise visible.** Develop simple ways for employees to identify where relevant expertise sits and how to access it.
* **Use live exchange selectively.** Combine curated content with peer learning, case discussions, expert sessions and communities where human exchange adds more value than a static asset.

## 3. Knowledge Capture and Curation

* **Build a repeatable sourcing model.** Build effective relationships and effective ways to source and identify potential stories.Create practical ways to extract expertise, lessons learned, playbooks and examples across Modaxo without placing unnecessary burden on business leaders and domain experts.
* **Capture what works.** Identify proven practices and relevant stories, validate them with the right experts and turn them into reusable enterprise assets.
* **Protect critical expertise.** Identify institutional knowledge at risk through leadership changes, retirement, transformation or acquisition, and establish proportionate methods to capture and transfer it.
* **Curate before creating.** Reuse, adapt or signpost strong existing material where possible and commission new content only where a genuine gap exists.
* **Support acquisition learning.** Build mechanisms to capture valuable expertise and practices from acquired businesses and make relevant Modaxo knowledge easier for new businesses and leaders to access.

## 4. Priority Capability and Learning Content

* **Lead the content roadmap.** Translate Modaxo global priorities into a sequenced roadmap of flagship knowledge and learning content, with clear audiences, outcomes, owners and delivery routes for both business and functions.
* **Accelerate AI capability in the near term.** Own the knowledge and learning content that helps leaders and employees understand the impact of AI, build relevant judgement and adapt their work, partnering with the AI CoE and Transformation team and other experts.
* **Build for application.** Shape content around real decisions, tools, examples and behaviour change.
* **Commission specialist expertise.** Pull from subject matter experts, other writers, facilitators and internal production teams as required. This role is accountable for the content outcome, not expected to be the technical expert on every topic.
* **Shape pathways and experiences.** Connect assets into practical journeys for priority audiences, including leaders, new joiners, acquired businesses and functional communities.

## 6. Insight, Adoption and Continuous Improvement

* **Measure usefulness.** Define measures that show whether people can find, trust, apply and reuse priority knowledge. Quality is more important than volume.
* **Build feedback loops.** Use platform data, search patterns, stakeholder feedback and learner evidence to understand demand, gaps and friction.
* **Maintain a living backlog.** Regularly review the roadmap based on strategic need, evidence of use, duplication and changing business priorities.
* **Demonstrate value.** Report clearly on adoption, quality, reach, application and selected business outcomes.

## 7.   Knowledge Architecture and Governance

* **Design the architecture.** Establish a practical taxonomy, metadata and content model so people can find relevant knowledge by topic, role, business need, audience and format.
* **Set the quality bar.** Define minimum standards for accuracy, format, accessibility, ownership, approval, source attribution and review.
* **Manage the lifecycle.** Put clear review, version control, archive and retirement processes in place so the knowledge base remains current rather than becoming a static repository.
* **Create accountable ownership.** Ensure priority assets have named business owners and subject matter validators, with clear responsibilities for maintenance.
* **Enable trusted search and reuse.** Work with system and digital workplace specialists so content is structured, tagged and maintained in a way that supports effective discovery and appropriate future AI-assisted retrieval.

  

The role will work across the organisation and will need to build credibility with senior leaders and practitioners globally.

# 

# **What success will look like?**

## First 12 months

* A clear Modaxo global knowledge and content strategy, operating model and 12 & 24 month knowledge roadmap agreed with the relevant leaders and reviewed on a defined cadence.
* Two to three flagship priorities delivered with evidence of improved understanding, application or time-to-competency. AI capability is an early priority. Evidence of building strong relationships with key stakeholders and identifying and delivering strong learning pathways and stories.
* A functioning knowledge-sourcing network across businesses and functions, with a repeatable route for capturing stories, playbooks, tools and lessons learned.
* A baseline view of current content, duplication, gaps and critical knowledge at risk, with agreed action for the highest-value areas.
* Useful adoption and quality measures in place, moving beyond course completion to include findability, reuse, freshness, confidence and application.
* A minimum viable enterprise governance framework in use, including named ownership, review cycles and retirement standards for priority content.
* Clear working boundaries and productive partnerships with AI Transformation, HR Systems, Communications, IT and business-owned content experts.

## Medium to long term

* Modaxo has a trusted enterprise knowledge content and governance model that scales as the Group grows.
* Priority expertise can be found and reused across businesses without undermining local autonomy.
* Critical knowledge is captured and transferred during acquisition, leadership transition and organisational change.
* Leaders and employees can access practical, current content that strengthens AI capability, leadership depth, succession and business performance.
* Duplication is reduced and strong local practice is more consistently surfaced, validated and scaled.
* Knowledge governance is embedded through a federated network of accountable owners and contributors.

  

# **About you**

## Experience and expertise

* You will have a strong track record of setting enterprise knowledge, content or capability strategy and translating it into a focused, prioritised roadmap aligned with business needs.
* You will demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and engaging business units across a complex, global, multi-entity decentralised organisation, including working effectively without formal authority and have proven ability to identify, source and draw out expertise, insight and effective practice from senior leaders, subject-matter experts and practitioners.
* You have strong content strategy and editorial experience, with the ability to turn complex or specialist knowledge into clear, engaging and practical content without losing accuracy.
* Experience selecting and combining different channels and formats to build practical capability. This may include messaging, playbooks, tools, case studies, digital resources, structured learning, live experiences and peer exchange, rather than written content alone.
* You will be setting priorities, governance and quality standards, and commissioning work through subject-matter experts, writers, learning specialists, creative teams or external partners rather than personally producing every element, your track record of designing or materially improving an enterprise knowledge ecosystem, including practical approaches to sourcing, curation, ownership, findability, reuse and lifecycle management is key.
* Experience using evidence, stakeholder feedback and analytics to prioritise a portfolio of knowledge and capability needs and to assess findability, adoption, application and value.
* Good grounding in adult learning and instructional design, with experience shaping learning pathways and designing for retention, application and behaviour change rather than information delivery alone and well as shaping practical digital learning and capability solutions. Familiarity with authoring tools and platforms such as Articulate 360, Docebo, SharePoint or equivalent would be useful, but this is not a systems administration role.
* Experience in a technology, software, professional services, acquisitive or federated business environment is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting AI capability, acquisition integration, leadership development, organisational change or communities of practice would be valuable

  

## Skills and attributes

* **Influential without authority:** Builds trust across autonomous businesses and aligns diverse senior stakeholders around shared priorities, common standards, and practical outcomes.
* **Strategic and commercially grounded:** Connects knowledge, capability, and content decisions to business priorities, focusing resources on areas of greatest value and impact.
* **Exceptional judgement:** Distinguishes reusable organisational knowledge from information that should remain local or temporary, making sound decisions on what to create, curate, scale, adapt, or signpost.
* **Stakeholder management and executive influence:** Extensive experience engaging, influencing, and building credibility with senior executives and business leaders in complex, matrixed organisations.

Strong Data Governance capability will be central to the role. The postholder will be accountable for strengthening and embedding the policies, ownership, tooling and culture required to ensure data is trusted, secure and compliant, while taking a pragmatic approach to the pace of change the business can absorb.

The role requires a strong, credible leader with proven delivery experience, sound financial management, exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, and the resilience and adaptability to thrive in a fast-moving, challenging and ambiguous environment. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in maturing and transforming Data and Analytics. While ensuring smooth transitions while maintaining stakeholder trust. Reporting to the Senior Director, Analytics & Data Management, this role will be pivotal in driving the organization's data transformation journey. **Principal Accountabilities:**

  

1. **Strategic Leadership & Data Roadmap**

* Translate strategy into a prioritized, sequenced and costed portfolio of initiatives, with clear milestones, dependencies, trade-offs and measurable outcomes.

* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on emerging data and AI trends, platform direction and the opportunities and risks they present to the business.

* Ensure the roadmap balances near-term delivery commitments (including legacy migration) with longer-term capability building and innovation.

* Contribute to the wider Cencora and International Business Group data community, aligning UK plans with global standards, platforms and shared services where appropriate.

2. **Data Delivery Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end delivery of data products aligned to the Data & Analytics strategy.

* Oversee the planning, prioritization and execution of projects across multiple business areas.

* Establish delivery frameworks and standards to ensure consistency, quality and speed of delivery.

* Create clear delivery timelines, monitor progress, and address risks or delays proactively.

* Document and present the value of each data product delivered to the business.

* Lead the transition from legacy systems (e.g., Cognos, Oracle, Qlik) to modern cloud-based platforms (Azure, Databricks and Power BI), including decommissioning plans and managing business continuity throughout.

* Mature Data Quality capabilities by embedding proactive monitoring, clear ownership and measurable standards, while streamlining root-cause analysis and corrective action to resolve issues efficiently, prevent recurrence and improve trust in data.

3. **Business Value Realization**

* Ensure data and analytics initiatives are explicitly linked to strategic priorities and measurable business outcomes, including improved customer service, operational efficiency, revenue, margin, risk reduction and colleague productivity.

* Partner with business owners to define clear success measures, baselines, benefit targets and ownership before delivery begins.

* Embed data products and insights into business processes and decision-making, driving adoption and the changes in behavior required to realize value.

* Track and report benefits transparently throughout the delivery lifecycle, intervening where adoption or value is below expectation and ensuring corrective actions are agreed.

* Use evidence from delivered outcomes to refine priorities, scale successful solutions and continuously improve the return on Data & Analytics investment.

4. **AI & Innovation**

* Execute a pragmatic AI strategy that identifies where AI, machine learning and automation can streamline processes and enhance the quality, speed and impact of data and analytics output.

* Embed AI-enabled ways of working across the data function (for example automated data quality monitoring, AI-assisted development and testing, metadata and documentation generation, and natural-language access to insight).

* Partner with business areas to identify, prioritize and deliver high-value AI use cases across the pharmaceutical supply chain, commercial and operational activities, with a clear business case for each.

* Ensure AI is adopted responsibly, with appropriate controls for ethics, transparency, security, regulatory compliance and human oversight, working with Legal, Compliance, Information Security and global colleagues.

* Build AI literacy and confidence within the team and the wider business, and evaluate emerging tools and vendors to keep the function at the leading edge.

5. **Data Governance & Compliance**

* Assess the current maturity of data governance and lead the design and delivery of a pragmatic, phased improvement plan, with defined maturity targets and progress reporting.

* Establish and embed the core governance framework: policies and standards, data ownership and stewardship, data catalogue and lineage, data quality rules and monitoring, master and reference data management, and access controls.

* Ensure all data initiatives comply with organizational governance frameworks and regulatory standards and the requirements of a regulated healthcare and pharmaceutical distribution environment.

* Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, Information Security and Privacy teams to maintain data security, privacy and quality.

* Establish robust processes for data governance, including documentation, auditing and reporting, and chair or facilitate the data governance forums needed to sustain them.

* Build a culture of data accountability by making governance practical, proportionate and embedded in delivery rather than a separate control activity.

6. **Financial & Commercial Management**

* Manage the Data & Analytics delivery budget (operating and capital), including forecasting, variance analysis and robust financial reporting to senior leadership.

* Build and defend business cases, and ensure investment is prioritized towards the initiatives with the greatest return and strategic value.

* Plan resources and headcount to match the roadmap, making clear, evidence-based recommendations when demand exceeds capacity.

* Monitor and manage cloud-based data infrastructure, including usage, capacity, performance and cost, to optimize investment, maintain effective financial control and maximize the benefits delivered to Alliance Healthcare UK.

7. **Stakeholder Management & Engagement**

* Build strong relationships with business leaders, ensuring their data needs are prioritized and met.

* Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, balancing competing demands and managing expectations.

* Communicate complex technical concepts, including AI and governance, in a clear, business-friendly manner.

* Negotiate timelines, resources and deliverables to ensure alignment across the organization.

* Translate complex data delivery challenges into clear, business-relevant narratives.

* Facilitate steering committees, governance forums and executive reporting.

* Lead Data Fluency and Data Culture initiatives, increasing confidence in using data and AI across the business.

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion and continuous improvement within the delivery team.

* Identify and address capability gaps, ensuring the organization builds robust data delivery, governance and AI competencies, through hiring, development and partnerships.

Help us redefine how complex software products get designed.
If you're a designer who enjoys complexity, questions assumptions, likes making things and believes there is nearly always a better way of solving a problem, we'd really like to hear from you.
What we have already started
We're changing how we design products by bringing design, prototyping and user learning much closer together. We want designers to be able to explore ideas, make them real and learn from users without unnecessary hand-offs or delay.
That means shortening the distance between:
Idea → Prototype → User Feedback → Learning → Better Solution
We're increasingly enabling designers to work with real coded components and functional prototypes, so ideas can be explored and tested in something much closer to the real product.
You do not need to be a software engineer or write code, but you should be excited about learning new ways of working and about the rapidly changing relationship between design, AI and software development.
You won't just use our design system. You'll help create it.
We're modernising complex, long-established software products. That creates an unusual design opportunity. You won't be joining an organisation where every interaction has already been solved and documented in a mature design system. Instead, you'll encounter difficult and sometimes unfamiliar interaction problems. We expect our designers to investigate those problems, identify patterns, establish principles, test solutions against real-world scenarios and help turn what we learn into reusable product standards and design patterns. You'll therefore be helping to shape not just individual features, but the design language of our future products.
Qualifications
The kind of designer we're looking for
We're deliberately not defining this role by a specific number of years' experience. We're much more interested in the complexity of the problems you've solved, how you think and the impact you've personally had.
You're analytical
You enjoy getting beneath the surface of a problem. You're comfortable absorbing complex information, identifying relationships, separating evidence from assumptions and finding structure in something that initially appears messy.
You're curious
If you don't understand something, you'll keep asking questions until you do. You want to understand how users think, why existing processes developed, what constraints are real and which ones exist simply because "that's how we've always done it." You enjoy the opportunity to tackle complex, unfamiliar problems and make sense of them.
You're a systems thinker
You don't see a product as a collection of screens. You think about workflows, behaviours, relationships, information, dependencies, states and consequences. You understand that changing one part of a complex product can have implications somewhere completely different.
You challenge constructively
You're respectful of what already exists, but not constrained by it.
You'll challenge product requirements, existing behaviours and even the premise of a problem when you believe there's a better approach. You're equally comfortable having your own ideas challenged.
You're decisive
You understand that perfect information rarely exists. You'll gather evidence where it's available, apply judgement where it isn't, explore alternatives and then make a recommendation. You'll be able to explain not just what you've designed, but
but why you believe it's the best decision given the evidence available.
You're a maker
You don't want your contribution to end with research reports, workshops and diagrams. You want to turn ideas into something tangible, put it in front of users, observe what happens and improve it.
You're adaptable
New tools and AI are changing what an individual designer can accomplish. We're looking for someone who finds that exciting rather than threatening. We don't expect you to arrive knowing every tool we'll use in the future. We do expect you to be curious enough to learn them.
You're collaborative
You don't believe good design happens in isolation. You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, domain experts and users, bringing people into the problem rather than simply presenting them with the answer. You're comfortable influencing without authority and helping a team build shared understanding around difficult decisions.
Your background
You might come from enterprise software, B2B SaaS, healthcare, financial services, engineering, logistics, government, data products or another complex professional domain. You may have worked in an established product team, a consultancy or as a contractor.
Experience in our particular software sector isn't essential. What matters more is your ability to enter an unfamiliar problem space, ask intelligent questions, understand it quickly and turn that understanding into thoughtful product decisions. You'll be comfortable working with ambiguity, using curiosity, creativity and judgement to find a way through it.
You'll build strong, long-term relationships across product and engineering and be able to make complex ideas understandable to people with different perspectives and expertise.
As the team evolves, we expect you to evolve with it, deepening your expertise, learning new capabilities and helping shape how we work.
What to expect from us
A long-term career as a fully embedded member of the team, working in an industry where the quality of the experiences we design can genuinely help people and, in some circumstances, even help save lives.
We don't want recruitment to feel like a series of tests you need to pass. Our conversations will give you the opportunity to talk openly about how you think, the problems you've tackled, the decisions you've made and the perspectives you would bring to our team.
We're genuinely interested in what makes you different and how you could become a pivotal part of our organisation. The better we're able to understand what you're capable of, what motivates you and the impact you could have, the easier it will be for both of us to decide whether this is the right fit.

# Business Analyst

The Business Analyst is a trusted partner to senior leadership, aligned to a specific area of the business and embedded within it. Working side by side with the Managing Director and Commercial Director day to day, their core purpose is to understand how the area really works and to find and unlock opportunities across people, process and systems.  
  
This is a business improvement role at heart, with a remit that reaches well beyond IT. Many of the biggest opportunities lie in the way work is organised and carried out day to day, how teams are structured, how processes flow, and how effort is spent and often have little to do with technology. The Business Analyst is there to spot those opportunities, make the case for change, and help deliver measurable benefits.  
  
Where an opportunity does call for technology, the Business Analyst is also the route into IT, capturing and shaping the requirement and taking it to the relevant Product Owner and delivery team, so nothing is lost between the business and delivery. The role sits within the business area and works to its leadership, while keeping a close, joined-up link with IT and Product Owners.  
  
The Business Analyst also works directly with clients to support the delivery of our contracts and helps coordinate and manage work with third-party suppliers and partners. It calls for someone as comfortable in a boardroom conversation about commercial strategy as they are mapping a process or shaping a requirement.

## Key Responsibilities

**Partnering with Leadership & Clients**

* Work side by side with the Managing Director and Commercial Director day to day, as part of their team and a dependable point of contact for improvement and change.
* Translate strategic and commercial objectives into practical, deliverable pieces of work.
* Work directly with clients to support the delivery of our contracts, understanding their requirements and representing their needs within the business.
* Build strong, trusted relationships at every level — from front-line operational teams to executive leadership, and externally with clients and contract partners.
* Facilitate workshops, interviews, and working sessions to draw out needs, resolve conflicting priorities, and build consensus.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, tailoring the message to the audience — from detailed working documents to concise executive summaries.

**Identifying Opportunity across People, Process & Systems**

* Take time to understand how the area operates end to end, building a clear picture of where value is created and where it is lost.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve, looking through three lenses:

1. **People** - how teams are organised; where capability, capacity, roles, or ways of working could be strengthened; and where effort is duplicated or misdirected.
2. **Process** - where processes are inefficient, inconsistent, manual, or carry unnecessary risk, and how they could be simplified or redesigned.
3. **Systems** - where better use of existing systems and data, or new technology, could remove friction, save time, or unlock growth.

* Build the case for change - quantifying the benefit, the effort, and the priority so leadership can make informed decisions.
* Recognise that many of the best opportunities are non-technical, and pursue improvement wherever the value lies, not only where a system is involved.

**Business Process Improvement**

* Analyse current (“as-is”) processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Design and document improved (“to-be”) ways of working that deliver measurable benefit.
* Produce clear process maps, procedures, and supporting documentation.
* Support the implementation of process changes, ensuring they are understood, adopted, and embedded across the business.
* Track and measure the impact of process changes against agreed outcomes.

**Requirements & the Route into IT**

* When a business need calls for technology, act as the route into IT and systems delivery — the first point of contact for capturing what the area needs.
* Elicit, analyse, challenge, and prioritise requirements from stakeholders across multiple functions.
* Distinguish clearly between business needs, user requirements, and solution constraints
* Translate requirements into clear, well-formed inputs for Product Owners, maintaining traceability from business objective through to delivered outcome, so nothing is lost between the business and delivery teams.

**Managing Work with Third Parties**

* Help coordinate and manage work with third-party suppliers, vendors, and contract partners.
* Ensure external work is clearly scoped, aligned to business priorities, and delivering the intended value.
* Act as a joined-up point of contact between the business, IT, and third parties, keeping activity visible and on track.

**System Rollouts & Business Change**

* Support the rollout and implementation of new systems and solutions across the organisation.
* Assess the impact of change on people, processes, and ways of working.
* Develop and support change and adoption activity, including communications, training material, and readiness assessments.
* Help teams transition smoothly through change, managing resistance and building buy-in.
* Ensure the business is prepared, supported, and confident ahead of any go-live.

**User Acceptance Testing (UAT)**

* Plan, coordinate, and support UAT for new and changed systems.
* Develop test scenarios and acceptance criteria based on documented requirements.
* Work with business users to execute testing and validate that solutions meet the agreed need.
* Ensure sign-off criteria are clear, met, and evidenced before go-live.

**Defect & Issue Management**

* Log, triage, and prioritise defects raised during testing and after implementation.
* Investigate issues, gather supporting detail, and clearly articulate the impact to delivery teams.
* Manage defects through to resolution, tracking status and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Distinguish between defects, change requests, and user error, routing each appropriately.

**Governance, Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation across opportunities, processes, requirements, and change activity.
* Provide clear, timely progress updates and reporting to leadership.
* Support the prioritisation of work in line with commercial, operational, and contractual priorities.
* Ensure work is delivered in line with relevant governance, standards, and controls.

**Key Relationships**

* **Internal** - Managing Director and Commercial Director (day-to-day leadership); operational and commercial teams; IT Product Owners and delivery teams; business change and support functions.
* **External** - Clients and contract partners; third-party suppliers and system vendors.

**Scope & Dimensions**

* Aligned to a specific area of the business, operating across its functions and contracts.
* Works independently, managing own workload and competing priorities.
* Influences without direct authority, relying on credibility, communication, and stakeholder management.
* Contributes directly to the performance, efficiency, and improvement of the area and its contracts.

## Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

**Essential**

* Proven experience in a Business Analyst role, ideally within an operational or commercially driven environment.
* A track record of identifying and delivering improvement across people, process and systems - not solely technology change.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence and credibility to work directly with senior leadership and with clients.
* Experience working directly with clients to support the delivery of contracts.
* Strong process analysis and mapping capability (as-is / to-be).
* Excellent requirements gathering, elicitation, and documentation skills.
* Experience supporting business change, system rollouts, and adoption activity.
* Experience planning and supporting user acceptance testing.
* Experience managing defects and issues through to resolution.
* Experience coordinating or managing work with third-party suppliers or partners.

**Desirable**

* Experience working alongside Product Owners and Agile delivery teams.
* Experience in a relevant sector (e.g. utilities, infrastructure, construction, services).
* Familiarity with business analysis and change frameworks and methodologies.

**Qualifications**

* Individuals in existing roles who do not yet hold this qualification will be supported by Network Plus to complete it.

**Personal Attributes & Behaviours**

* Commercially aware - understands the wider business context and the drivers behind change.
* Curious - asks the right questions to get beneath the surface of a problem and spot opportunity.
* Credible and confident - able to hold their own with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively.
* Pragmatic - balances the ideal solution with what is deliverable and beneficial.
* Collaborative - builds strong working relationships and brings people with them.

**What Success Looks Like**
