## Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason - the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

## How you'll help us achieve it

We're looking for an experienced security engineer who's independent, excited about getting things done, and ready to hit the ground running. You'll primarily be responsible for our application security, working with our product teams to work on new systems to enhance our security posture. Our customers trust us with their money, and you'll be at the forefront of making sure we retain that trust!

This broadly scoped role will allow you to get your hands on many different types of security projects, from direct application security to helping our infrastructure team think about security for our databases.

As we integrate AI-powered agents into our engineering and operations workflows, you'll help define and enforce the guardrails around how we use them safely. This includes securing agentic tooling against prompt injection, excessive permissions, and data exfiltration - and building the policies and technical controls to govern AI usage across the company.

Some experience with common industry certifications like ISO-27001 and PCI-DSS would be beneficial, although you won't be expected to run or oversee audits.

Our to-do list changes constantly, but here are some recent projects:

* Design our agentic SIEM/SecOps pipelines to evaluate and tune AI-driven triage, alerting, and response automation
* Secure our MCP integrations against prompt injection, tool misuse, and credential exposure
* Tune and maintain code security review agents tailored to Wave's codebase, threat model, and regulatory environment
* Develop internal AI governance standards covering acceptable use, data handling, and audit requirements for LLM-powered tools
* Centralise application-level login and permissions enforcement including privileged access management
* Rework our approach to secrets management with ephemeral secrets and tighter access scopes

In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

# Senior Data Engineer

**Join us and rebuild our data stack for AI-first tech and data teams.**We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who will redesign how data turns into intelligence at Xeneta. Our engineers, data scientists and analysts already build data products with tools like Claude Code, but the AI agents are only as good as the data they can reach. Our data stack (Snowflake, dbt, AWS, OpenMetadata) is already top-of-class and has been recognised by peers at conferences - your job is to take it to the next level.    
  
You will cut the time it takes to build and ship a data model from days to hours. You will own our data architecture end to end: modelling, pipelines, governance and the stack underneath. You will decide what gets rebuilt, evolved, or retired. You will make data discoverable, trusted and usable by humans and agents alike.   
  
Xeneta provides the data and intelligence that underpins ocean and air freight decisions for the largest buyers and sellers in the market. Your work is what makes that intelligence possible.   
  
*Location: Bucharest (RO), London (UK), Oslo (NO)*

## What you will be doing

* Own the pipelines that feed the Xeneta platform with data, and decide what gets rebuilt, evolved or retired.
* Redesign our data models in Snowflake and dbt so a data scientist or engineer can go from an idea to shipped model in hours, not days - without messing up the critical data in production.
* Make our data usable by AI agents: clean semantics, documented lineage, and metadata that Claude Code and other AI tools can read and act on reliably.
* Educate the tech and data teams as well as the wider organisation on using data with AI tools.
* Set the governance rules for how data is defined, owned and accessed, and build them into the stack instead of writing them into a policy.
* Automate the repetitive work: access provisioning and approvals, onboarding new data sources, adding data quality checks, and keeping documentation and lineage current.

## What we are looking for

Among your skills and prior experience, you should have:

* 5+ years of experience in a Data Engineer role, with a proven track record in designing scalable and reliable data architecture.
* Strong opinion on what good user- and developer experience looks like in your area, and a desire to constantly improve the tools that you use.
* Experience using AI tools like Claude Code as the default way you write, review and maintain systems.
* Expertise with data pipeline tools, cloud services, and Snowflake ecosystem.
* Proven expertise in modeling data using advanced SQL.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

Among your personal traits, the following would be helpful in the role:

* You are a team player, and you enjoy learning and improving the team around you and yourself.
* You have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, curiosity, and daring when venturing into unknown territory.
* You have strong communication skills: you keep stakeholders up to date, you empathize with user problems, you can rally peers around a solution, and you are not afraid to push for a decision when consensus is hard to reach.

## What we offer

* You will have **trust, autonomy, impact** as you will own the tools and processes that make a huge difference both inside the org and towards our customers, and we will enable you to make the right decisions instead of holding you back with committee approvals.
* We have a **transparent and open work environment** where information is shared openly, everyone is expected to make an impact, and each person is expected to voice their ideas and give feedback directly.
* You will receive an **individual education budget and you can educate yourself during work hours**: you can spend several hours each month attending courses, reading books, or getting involved in communities.
* We provide **flexible working hours** as well as a **generous vacation plan**, so you can recharge properly and bring your absolute best to work.
* **If in Bucharest**: We offer full-time position employed through GI Group, our staffing partner in Romania.

## About Xeneta

At Xeneta, we have been on a mission to transform the ocean and air freight markets since 2012. We are doing this by building a data platform that provides intelligence to the very opaque industry of buying and selling containerized freight. Now, Xeneta is the leading freight rate benchmarking and market analytics platform—creating transparency and empowering our customers to make data-driven decisions.

Our customers include big brands such as Kuehne+Nagel, Coca-Cola Company, Unilever, Pfizer, Flexport, L'Oreál, Nestlé, and Volvo.

Headquartered in Oslo, with offices in Hamburg, London and Jersey City and employees from over 60 different countries, we are a truly international company that celebrates diversity. We’re growing at a fast pace, helped in part by our latest investment round where APAX Digital invested $80M, and we are continuously searching for top talent and partners to join us on our mission.

Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. Xylem is seeking an experienced Project Engineer to lead the successful delivery of complex temporary pumping, bypass and dewatering projects across the UK water and utilities sector. In this role you will be working alongside leading Tier 1 contractors and major utility clients including Anglian Water, Severn Trent Water and other key framework customers, you will take ownership of projects from initial handover through mobilisation, installation, operation and final demobilisation.

  

This is an exciting opportunity for an established Project Engineer looking to take a leading role in delivering critical infrastructure projects that directly support the operation and maintenance of essential water and wastewater networks.

You will work at the interface between engineering, operations, commercial teams and customers, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on programme and within budget.

  

Project Delivery

·       Manage and coordinate the delivery of pump rental, bypass pumping and temporary works projects from award through to completion.

·       Act as the primary project lead between customers, operations teams, engineering teams, suppliers and subcontractors.

·       Develop and maintain project programmes, resource plans and delivery schedules.

·       Ensure customer requirements are fully understood and translated into successful project delivery plans.

·       Support business growth through the delivery of exceptional customer service and project performance.

  

Technical Leadership

·       Review project requirements and ensure proposed pumping solutions are practical, safe and commercially viable.

·       Provide technical oversight during the planning and delivery of temporary pumping installations.

·       Work closely with electrical, mechanical and temporary works specialists to develop robust project solutions.

·       Support technical reviews covering pump selection, generators, variable speed drives, control systems, pipelines, lifting operations and associated temporary works.

·       Resolve technical issues that arise during project execution.

  

Commercial & Contract Management

·       Monitor project costs, utilisation and expenditure against approved budgets.

·       Support forecasting, reporting and project financial performance reviews.

·       Manage variations, compensation events and project changes where applicable.

·       Ensure commercial risks and opportunities are identified and managed effectively.

·       Maintain a strong understanding of NEC contracts and project delivery obligations.

  

Health, Safety, Environment & Quality

·       Ensure projects are delivered in full compliance with company, client and legislative requirements.

·       Lead project planning activities, including RAMS reviews, project documentation and risk assessments.

·       Promote a positive safety culture across project teams and supply chain partners.

·       Ensure all project personnel and subcontractors operate to required competency and compliance standards.

Desirable
